    <!-- SCRIPT DE NAVEGACIÓN Y PARTICULAS FLOTANTES -->
    <script>
        const tgApp = window.Telegram?.WebApp;
        if (tgApp) {
            try {
                tgApp.expand();
                tgApp.ready();
            } catch(e) {}
        }

        function getRealTelegramUser() {
            const tgUser = tgApp?.initDataUnsafe?.user;
            if (tgUser && tgUser.id) {
                const tgHandle = tgUser.username ? `@${tgUser.username}` : (tgUser.first_name || `Usuario_${tgUser.id}`);
                return { id: String(tgUser.id), username: tgHandle };
            }

            const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
            const urlId = urlParams.get('tg_id');
            if (urlId && urlId !== 'None' && urlId !== 'undefined' && urlId.trim() !== '') {
                const urlName = urlParams.get('tg_username') || `Noble_${urlId}`;
                return { id: urlId, username: urlName.startsWith('@') ? urlName : `@${urlName}` };
            }

            return {
                id: localStorage.getItem('current_tg_id') || '123456789',
                username: localStorage.getItem('current_tg_user') || 'Invitado'
            };
        }

        // Navegación Fluida con Telón Anti-Flicker
        window.universalNav = function(targetPath) {
            try {
                tgApp?.HapticFeedback?.impactOccurred('light');
            } catch(e) {}

            const user = getRealTelegramUser();
            const curtain = document.getElementById('page-transition-curtain');
            if (curtain) {
                curtain.classList.add('active');
            }

            const hashIndex = targetPath.indexOf('#');
            let hash = '';
            let pathAndQuery = targetPath;
            if (hashIndex !== -1) {
                hash = targetPath.substring(hashIndex);
                pathAndQuery = targetPath.substring(0, hashIndex);
            }

            const queryIndex = pathAndQuery.indexOf('?');
            let basePath = pathAndQuery;
            let extraParams = '';
            if (queryIndex !== -1) {
                basePath = pathAndQuery.substring(0, queryIndex);
                extraParams = '&' + pathAndQuery.substring(queryIndex + 1);
            }

            setTimeout(() => {
                window.location.href = `${basePath}?tg_id=${user.id}&tg_username=${encodeURIComponent(user.username)}${extraParams}${hash}`;
            }, 80);
        };

        window.navGo = window.universalNav;
        window.getGlobalTgId = function() { return getRealTelegramUser().id; };
        window.getGlobalTgUser = function() { return getRealTelegramUser().username; };

        // Efecto flotante de recompensas (Oro / XP)
        window.spawnRewardPill = function(text, x, y, isGold = true) {
            const pill = document.createElement('div');
            pill.innerText = text;
            pill.className = `fixed pointer-events-none z-[999999] px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-black font-mono shadow-2xl border ${
                isGold 
                ? 'bg-amber-950/90 text-yellow-300 border-yellow-400 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(234,179,8,0.7)]' 
                : 'bg-purple-950/90 text-purple-200 border-purple-400 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(168,85,247,0.7)]'
            }`;
            pill.style.left = `${(x || window.innerWidth / 2) - 40}px`;
            pill.style.top = `${(y || window.innerHeight / 2) - 20}px`;
            pill.style.transition = 'all 1.1s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.9, 0.3, 1)';
            document.body.appendChild(pill);

            setTimeout(() => {
                pill.style.transform = 'translateY(-65px) scale(1.15)';
                pill.style.opacity = '0';
            }, 25);
            setTimeout(() => pill.remove(), 1150);
        };

        (function highlightActiveTab() {
            const path = window.location.pathname;
            document.querySelectorAll('.nav-tab').forEach(tab => {
                const tabPath = tab.getAttribute('data-nav');
                const isActive = (tabPath === '/' && path === '/') || (tabPath !== '/' && path.startsWith(tabPath));
                
                if (isActive) {
                    tab.className = "nav-tab w-full flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-1.5 px-0.5 text-vip-gold select-none rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-b from-yellow-500/20 via-yellow-500/10 to-transparent border border-vip-gold/40 shadow-[0_0_14px_rgba(212,175,55,0.3)]";
                    tab.querySelector('span:last-child').className = "text-[8px] sm:text-[8.5px] font-black uppercase tracking-tight mt-1 text-vip-gold";
                }
            });
        })();

        window.showVipAlert = function(msg, title = "Aviso de la Corte", icon = "👑") {
            try { window.Telegram?.WebApp?.HapticFeedback?.notificationOccurred('warning'); } catch(e) {}
            document.getElementById('vip-modal-title').innerText = title;
            document.getElementById('vip-modal-text').innerText = msg;
            document.getElementById('vip-modal-icon').innerText = icon;
            document.getElementById('vip-global-modal').classList.remove('hidden');
        };
        window.closeVipAlert = function() {
            document.getElementById('vip-global-modal').classList.add('hidden');
        };

        window.openImageLightbox = function(src, caption = '') {
            try { window.Telegram?.WebApp?.HapticFeedback?.impactOccurred('medium'); } catch(e) {}
            const modal = document.getElementById('image-lightbox-modal');
            const img = document.getElementById('lightbox-img');
            const cap = document.getElementById('lightbox-caption');
            if (modal && img) {
                img.src = src;
                cap.innerText = caption ? `«${caption}»` : '';
                modal.classList.remove('hidden');
            }
        };
        window.closeImageLightbox = function() {
            const modal = document.getElementById('image-lightbox-modal');
            if (modal) modal.classList.add('hidden');
        };
    </script>
</body>
</html>

  <!-- SCRIPT AJAX EN VIVO (CERO PARPADEOS NI SALTOS DE SCROLL) -->
  <script>
    const adminId = '{{ admin_tg_id }}';
    const csrfToken = '{{ csrf_token }}';

    let currentModalTargetId = null;

    function openGoldModal(targetId, targetName, currentBalance) {
      currentModalTargetId = targetId;
      document.getElementById('modal-gold-target-id').innerText = targetId;
      document.getElementById('modal-gold-target-name').innerText = targetName;
      document.getElementById('modal-gold-current-balance').innerText = currentBalance;
      document.getElementById('modal-gold-amount').value = 500;
      document.getElementById('gold-modal').classList.remove('hidden');
    }

    function closeGoldModal() {
      document.getElementById('gold-modal').classList.add('hidden');
    }

    function setModalGoldAmount(val) {
      document.getElementById('modal-gold-amount').value = val;
    }

    function showToast(msg, isSuccess = true) {
      const toast = document.getElementById('admin-toast');
      toast.innerHTML = `
        <div class="p-3.5 rounded-2xl border text-xs font-bold shadow-2xl flex items-center justify-center gap-2 ${
          isSuccess 
          ? 'bg-emerald-950/95 border-emerald-500 text-emerald-200 shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(16,185,129,0.5)]' 
          : 'bg-rose-950/95 border-rose-500 text-rose-200 shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(244,63,94,0.5)]'
        }">
          <span>${isSuccess ? '✨' : '⚠️'}</span>
          <span>${msg}</span>
        </div>`;
      toast.classList.remove('opacity-0', 'translate-y-[-20px]');
      setTimeout(() => {
        toast.classList.add('opacity-0', 'translate-y-[-20px]');
      }, 3500);
    }

    // 🌟 ENVIAR AJUSTE DE ORO SIN RECARGAR LA PÁGINA
    async function submitGoldAction(mode) {
      const amount = parseInt(document.getElementById('modal-gold-amount').value, 10);
      if (isNaN(amount) || amount < 0) {
        alert("Ingresa un monto válido.");
        return;
      }

      const fd = new FormData();
      fd.append('accion', 'adjust_gold');
      fd.append('mode', mode);
      fd.append('amount', amount);
      fd.append('target_id', currentModalTargetId);
      fd.append('tg_id', adminId);
      fd.append('ajax', '1');
      fd.append('csrfmiddlewaretoken', csrfToken);

      closeGoldModal();

      try {
        const resp = await fetch(window.location.href, {
          method: 'POST',
          body: fd,
          headers: { 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest' }
        });
        const data = await resp.json();

        if (data.success) {
          // Actualizar saldo del usuario en la fila correspondiente
          const balanceElem = document.getElementById(`user-balance-${data.target_id}`);
          if (balanceElem) {
            balanceElem.innerText = `${data.new_balance} 🪙`;
          }

          // Efecto de iluminación en la fila
          const row = document.getElementById(`user-row-${data.target_id}`);
          if (row) {
            row.classList.add('flash-gold');
            setTimeout(() => row.classList.remove('flash-gold'), 1200);
          }

          showToast(data.message, true);
        } else {
          showToast(data.error || "Error al procesar", false);
        }
      } catch(e) {
        showToast("Error de conexión con el servidor", false);
      }
    }

    // 🌟 CAMBIAR ROL SIN RECARGAR
    async function ajaxChangeGameRole(targetId, newRole) {
      const fd = new FormData();
      fd.append('accion', 'change_game_role');
      fd.append('new_role', newRole);
      fd.append('target_id', targetId);
      fd.append('tg_id', adminId);
      fd.append('ajax', '1');
      fd.append('csrfmiddlewaretoken', csrfToken);

      try {
        const resp = await fetch(window.location.href, { method: 'POST', body: fd, headers: { 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest' } });
        const data = await resp.json();
        showToast(data.message, true);
      } catch(e) {}
    }

    // 🌟 CAMBIAR STAFF SIN RECARGAR
    async function ajaxChangeStaffRole(targetId, newStaff) {
      const fd = new FormData();
      fd.append('accion', 'change_staff_role');
      fd.append('new_staff', newStaff);
      fd.append('target_id', targetId);
      fd.append('tg_id', adminId);
      fd.append('ajax', '1');
      fd.append('csrfmiddlewaretoken', csrfToken);

      try {
        const resp = await fetch(window.location.href, { method: 'POST', body: fd, headers: { 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest' } });
        const data = await resp.json();
        showToast(data.message, true);
      } catch(e) {}
    }

    // 🌟 CONCEDER SALVOCONDUCTO SIN RECARGAR
    async function ajaxGrantShield(targetId, days) {
      const fd = new FormData();
      fd.append('accion', 'grant_shield');
      fd.append('shield_days', days);
      fd.append('target_id', targetId);
      fd.append('tg_id', adminId);
      fd.append('ajax', '1');
      fd.append('csrfmiddlewaretoken', csrfToken);

      try {
        const resp = await fetch(window.location.href, { method: 'POST', body: fd, headers: { 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest' } });
        const data = await resp.json();
        if (data.success) {
          const badge = document.getElementById(`shield-badge-${targetId}`);
          const daysSpan = document.getElementById(`shield-days-${targetId}`);
          if (badge) badge.classList.remove('hidden');
          if (daysSpan) daysSpan.innerText = data.days;
          showToast(data.message, true);
        }
      } catch(e) {}
    }

    // 🌟 BAN / DESBAN SIN RECARGAR
    async function ajaxToggleBan(targetId) {
      if (!confirm("¿Cambiar estado de mazmorra para este usuario?")) return;
      const fd = new FormData();
      fd.append('accion', 'toggle_ban');
      fd.append('target_id', targetId);
      fd.append('tg_id', adminId);
      fd.append('ajax', '1');
      fd.append('csrfmiddlewaretoken', csrfToken);

      try {
        const resp = await fetch(window.location.href, { method: 'POST', body: fd, headers: { 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest' } });
        const data = await resp.json();
        if (data.success) {
          const btn = document.getElementById(`ban-btn-${targetId}`);
          const badge = document.getElementById(`ban-badge-${targetId}`);
          if (data.is_banned) {
            btn.innerText = "Soltar";
            btn.className = "px-2 py-1 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-bold border active:scale-95 transition-all bg-emerald-950 text-emerald-200 border-emerald-600";
            if (badge) badge.classList.remove('hidden');
          } else {
            btn.innerText = "Mazmorra";
            btn.className = "px-2 py-1 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-bold border active:scale-95 transition-all bg-rose-950 text-rose-300 border-rose-700";
            if (badge) badge.classList.add('hidden');
          }
          showToast(data.message, true);
        }
      } catch(e) {}
    }

    function switchAdminTab(tabName) {
      ['censo', 'decretos', 'purgas', 'auditoria'].forEach(t => {
        const panel = document.getElementById(`adm-panel-${t}`);
        const btn = document.getElementById(`adm-tab-${t}`);
        if (panel && btn) {
          if (t === tabName) {
            panel.classList.remove('hidden');
            btn.className = "py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-yellow-500 text-black font-black";
          } else {
            panel.classList.add('hidden');
            btn.className = "py-2.5 rounded-xl text-stone-400 hover:text-white";
          }
        }
      });
    }

    function filtrarUsuarios() {
      const q = document.getElementById('searchInput').value.toLowerCase().trim();
      const items = document.querySelectorAll('.user-item');
      items.forEach(item => {
        const text = item.getAttribute('data-search') || '';
        item.style.display = text.includes(q) ? 'flex' : 'none';
      });
    }

    function universalNav(targetPath) {
      window.location.href = `${targetPath}?tg_id=${adminId}`;
    }
  </script>

</body>
</html>

    <script>
        async function payBail() {
            if (!confirm("¿Pagar 500 🪙 de fianza para salir de la mazmorra y recuperar tu honor?")) return;
            const btn = document.getElementById('btn-pay-bail');
            btn.disabled = true;
            btn.innerText = "Tramitando indulto...";

            const formData = new FormData();
            formData.append('tg_id', '{{ tg_id }}');
            formData.append('item_key', 'dungeon_bail');

            try {
                const resp = await fetch("/economy/bazar/buy/", {
                    method: 'POST',
                    body: formData,
                    headers: { 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest' }
                });
                const data = await resp.json();
                if (data.success) {
                    alert(data.message);
                    window.location.replace(`/?tg_id={{ tg_id }}`);
                } else {
                    alert(data.error);
                    btn.disabled = false;
                    btn.innerText = "⚖️ Pagar Fianza Real (500 🪙)";
                }
            } catch(e) {
                alert("Error de conexión al procesar fianza.");
                btn.disabled = false;
            }
        }
    </script>
</body>

<script>
    function universalNav(targetPath) {
        let tgId = '{{ tg_id }}';
        try {
            if (window.Telegram && window.Telegram.WebApp && window.Telegram.WebApp.initDataUnsafe && window.Telegram.WebApp.initDataUnsafe.user) {
                tgId = window.Telegram.WebApp.initDataUnsafe.user.id || tgId;
            }
        } catch(e) {}
        const sep = targetPath.includes('?') ? '&' : '?';
        window.location.href = tgId ? `${targetPath}${sep}tg_id=${tgId}` : targetPath;
    }

    async function unpinItemFromProfile(itemType, itemId, itemName) {
        if (!confirm(`¿Deseas desanclar «${itemName}» de tu Expositor de Honor?`)) return;
        try {
            const formData = new FormData();
            formData.append('type', itemType);
            formData.append('id', itemId);
            formData.append('name', itemName);

            let tgId = '{{ tg_id }}';
            try {
                if (window.Telegram && window.Telegram.WebApp && window.Telegram.WebApp.initDataUnsafe && window.Telegram.WebApp.initDataUnsafe.user) {
                    tgId = window.Telegram.WebApp.initDataUnsafe.user.id || tgId;
                }
            } catch(e) {}
            if (tgId) formData.append('tg_id', tgId);

            const csrfToken = document.querySelector('[name=csrfmiddlewaretoken]')?.value 
                || (document.cookie.match(/csrftoken=([^;]+)/) || [])[1] 
                || '';
            formData.append('csrfmiddlewaretoken', csrfToken);

            const resp = await fetch('/profile/pin-item/', {
                method: 'POST',
                body: formData,
                headers: { 
                    'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest',
                    'X-CSRFToken': csrfToken
                }
            });

            const data = await resp.json();
            if (data.success) {
                try { window.Telegram?.WebApp?.HapticFeedback?.notificationOccurred('success'); } catch(e) {}
                window.location.reload();
            } else {
                alert(data.error || 'No se pudo desanclar el ítem.');
            }
        } catch (e) {
            console.error(e);
            alert('Error al desanclar de la corte.');
        }
    }

    function switchProfileTab(tab) {
        const logros = document.getElementById('p-tab-logros');
        const ajustes = document.getElementById('p-tab-ajustes');
        const btnLogros = document.getElementById('p-tab-btn-logros');
        const btnAjustes = document.getElementById('p-tab-btn-ajustes');

        if (tab === 'ajustes') {
            logros.classList.add('hidden');
            ajustes.classList.remove('hidden');
            btnAjustes.className = "py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-vip-gold text-black font-black transition-all";
            btnLogros.className = "py-2.5 rounded-xl text-stone-400 hover:text-white transition-all";
        } else {
            ajustes.classList.add('hidden');
            logros.classList.remove('hidden');
            btnLogros.className = "py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-vip-gold text-black font-black transition-all";
            btnAjustes.className = "py-2.5 rounded-xl text-stone-400 hover:text-white transition-all";
        }
    }
</script>
{% endblock %}

<script>
    function playCollectorAudio(type) {
        try {
            const ctx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
            const now = ctx.currentTime;
            if (type === 'wobble') {
                const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
                const gain = ctx.createGain();
                osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(180, now);
                osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(320, now + 0.15);
                gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.15, now);
                gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.01, now + 0.2);
                osc.connect(gain); gain.connect(ctx.destination);
                osc.start(now); osc.stop(now + 0.2);
            } else if (type === 'fanfare_secret') {
                [523, 659, 784, 1046, 1318].forEach((freq, idx) => {
                    const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
                    const gain = ctx.createGain();
                    osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, now + idx * 0.06);
                    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.25, now + idx * 0.06);
                    gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.01, now + idx * 0.06 + 0.4);
                    osc.connect(gain); gain.connect(ctx.destination);
                    osc.start(now + idx * 0.06); osc.stop(now + idx * 0.06 + 0.45);
                });
            } else if (type === 'recycle') {
                [800, 1000, 1200].forEach((freq, idx) => {
                    const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
                    const gain = ctx.createGain();
                    osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, now + idx * 0.05);
                    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.18, now + idx * 0.05);
                    gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.01, now + idx * 0.05 + 0.2);
                    osc.connect(gain); gain.connect(ctx.destination);
                    osc.start(now + idx * 0.05); osc.stop(now + idx * 0.05 + 0.25);
                });
            } else {
                [440, 554, 659, 880].forEach((freq, idx) => {
                    const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
                    const gain = ctx.createGain();
                    osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, now + idx * 0.08);
                    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.2, now + idx * 0.08);
                    gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.01, now + idx * 0.08 + 0.3);
                    osc.connect(gain); gain.connect(ctx.destination);
                    osc.start(now + idx * 0.08); osc.stop(now + idx * 0.08 + 0.35);
                });
            }
        } catch(e){}
    }

    
    // 💡 Control de Iluminación de la Vitrina
    function setCabinetLighting(mode) {
        const cabinet = document.querySelector('#section-vitrina .popmart-cabinet');
        if (!cabinet) return;
        ['cabinet-light-palace', 'cabinet-light-neon', 'cabinet-light-diamond', 'cabinet-light-stealth'].forEach(cls => cabinet.classList.remove(cls));
        cabinet.classList.add('cabinet-light-' + mode);

        ['palace', 'neon', 'diamond', 'stealth'].forEach(m => {
            const btn = document.getElementById('light-btn-' + m);
            if (btn) {
                if (m === mode) {
                    btn.className = 'px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg bg-amber-500 text-black font-black transition-all';
                } else {
                    btn.className = 'px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg text-stone-400 hover:text-white transition-all';
                }
            }
        });
    }

    // 🏷️ Filtro de Categorías del Bazar
    function filterBazarCategory(category) {
        const items = document.querySelectorAll('.bazar-product-item');
        items.forEach(el => {
            if (category === 'all' || el.getAttribute('data-category') === category) {
                el.classList.remove('hidden');
            } else {
                el.classList.add('hidden');
            }
        });
        ['all', 'customization', 'status', 'consumable'].forEach(cat => {
            const btn = document.getElementById('bazar-cat-' + cat);
            if (btn) {
                if (cat === category) {
                    btn.className = 'bazar-cat-btn py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-amber-500 text-black font-black transition-all';
                } else {
                    btn.className = 'bazar-cat-btn py-1.5 rounded-lg text-stone-400 hover:text-white transition-all';
                }
            }
        });
    }

    function switchBazarTab(tabName) {
        ['popmart', 'vitrina', 'bazar', 'admin'].forEach(s => {
            const el = document.getElementById('section-' + s);
            const btn = document.getElementById('tab-btn-' + s);
            if (el) el.classList.toggle('hidden', s !== tabName);
            if (btn) btn.classList.toggle('bazar-tab-active', s === tabName);
        });
    }

    function openFigureDetailModal(id, name, imgUrl, seriesName, isSecret, isOwned, userQty, singlePrice, seriesId, blindPrice) {
        document.getElementById('detail-modal-name').textContent = name;
        document.getElementById('detail-modal-series').textContent = seriesName || 'Pop Mart';
        const imgEl = document.getElementById('detail-modal-img');

        document.getElementById('detail-modal-secret-badge').classList.toggle('hidden', !isSecret);

        const statusContainer = document.getElementById('detail-modal-status-badge');
        const actionsContainer = document.getElementById('detail-modal-actions');
        statusContainer.innerHTML = ''; actionsContainer.innerHTML = '';

        if (isOwned) {
            statusContainer.innerHTML = `<div class="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1 bg-emerald-950/80 border border-emerald-500/40 rounded-xl text-emerald-300 text-xs font-bold font-mono"><span>✓</span> En tu Vitrina (x${userQty})</div>`;
            let actionsHtml = `
                <button type="button" onclick="pinFigureToProfile(${id}, '${name.replace(/'/g, "\\'")}', '${(imgUrl || '').replace(/'/g, "\\'")}', '${(seriesName || 'Pop Mart').replace(/'/g, "\\'")}')"

                    <span>📌</span> <span>Fijar en Expositor de Mi Perfil</span>
                </button>
            `;
            if (userQty > 1) {

            }
            actionsContainer.innerHTML = actionsHtml;
        } else {
            statusContainer.innerHTML = `<div class="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1 bg-stone-900 border border-white/20 rounded-xl text-stone-400 text-xs font-bold"><span>🔒</span> No descubierta aún</div>`;
            actionsContainer.innerHTML = `
                <button type="button" onclick="closeFigureDetailModal(); buyBoutiqueItem(${id}, '${name.replace(/'/g, "\\\\'")}', ${singlePrice})" class="w-full py-2.5 bg-gradient-to-r from-yellow-500 to-amber-400 text-black font-black text-xs uppercase rounded-xl">✨ Compra Directa (${singlePrice} 🪙)</button>
                ${seriesId ? `<button type="button" onclick="closeFigureDetailModal(); openBlindBox(${seriesId}, '${seriesName.replace(/'/g, "\\\\'")}', ${blindPrice})" class="w-full py-2 bg-purple-950 border border-purple-500/40 text-purple-200 font-bold text-xs uppercase rounded-xl">🎲 Abrir Caja Sorpresa (${blindPrice} 🪙)</button>` : ''}
            `;
        }
        const modal = document.getElementById('figure-detail-modal');
        modal.classList.remove('hidden'); modal.classList.add('flex');
    }

        const m = document.getElementById('figure-detail-modal');

    async function recycleDuplicate(itemId, itemName) {
        if (!confirm(`¿Deseas empeñar 1 duplicado de «${itemName}» por oro?`)) return;
        const formData = new FormData();
        formData.append('ajax', '1');
        formData.append('csrfmiddlewaretoken', '{{ csrf_token }}');
        const resp = await fetch(`/economy/bazar/collectible/recycle/${itemId}/`, { method: 'POST', body: formData });
        const data = await resp.json();
        if (data.success) {
            playCollectorAudio('recycle');
            alert(data.message);
            window.location.reload();
        } else alert(data.error);
    }

    async function openBlindBox(seriesId, seriesName, price) {
        if (!confirm(`¿Abrir Caja Sorpresa de «${seriesName}» por ${price} 🪙?`)) return;
        playCollectorAudio('wobble');
        const modal = document.getElementById('blind-box-modal');
        const anim = document.getElementById('unbox-anim-container');
        const res = document.getElementById('unbox-result-container');
        modal.classList.remove('hidden'); modal.classList.add('flex');
        anim.classList.remove('hidden'); res.classList.add('hidden');

        const formData = new FormData();
        formData.append('ajax', '1');
        formData.append('csrfmiddlewaretoken', '{{ csrf_token }}');
        const resp = await fetch(`/economy/bazar/series/blind-box/${seriesId}/`, { method: 'POST', body: formData });
        const data = await resp.json();
        setTimeout(() => {
            if (data.success) {
                if (data.is_secret) playCollectorAudio('fanfare_secret');
                else playCollectorAudio('fanfare_regular');
                anim.classList.add('hidden'); res.classList.remove('hidden'); res.classList.add('flex');
                document.getElementById('reveal-series-name').textContent = seriesName;
                document.getElementById('reveal-figure-name').textContent = data.figure_name;
                document.getElementById('reveal-message').textContent = data.message;
                if (data.figure_image) document.getElementById('reveal-figure-img').src = data.figure_image;
                document.getElementById('reveal-secret-badge').classList.toggle('hidden', !data.is_secret);
            } else {
                closeBlindBoxModal(); alert(data.error);
            }
        }, 1200);
    }
    function closeBlindBoxModal() {
        const m = document.getElementById('blind-box-modal');
        m.classList.add('hidden'); m.classList.remove('flex');
        window.location.reload();
    }

    async function buyBoutiqueItem(itemId, itemName, price) {
        if (!confirm(`¿Comprar directamente «${itemName}» por ${price} 🪙?`)) return;
        const formData = new FormData();
        formData.append('ajax', '1');
        formData.append('csrfmiddlewaretoken', '{{ csrf_token }}');
        const resp = await fetch(`/economy/bazar/collectible/buy/${itemId}/`, { method: 'POST', body: formData });
        const data = await resp.json();
        if (data.success) { alert(data.message); window.location.reload(); }
        else alert(data.error);
    }

    async function buyStandardItem(itemCode, itemName, price) {
        if (!confirm(`¿Comprar «${itemName}» por ${price} 🪙?`)) return;
        const formData = new FormData();
        formData.append('item_code', itemCode);
        formData.append('ajax', '1');
        formData.append('csrfmiddlewaretoken', '{{ csrf_token }}');
        const resp = await fetch("/economy/bazar/buy/", { method: 'POST', body: formData });
        const data = await resp.json();
        if (data.success) { alert(data.message); window.location.reload(); }
        else alert(data.error);
    }

    function previewBatchFigures(input) {
        const c = document.getElementById('batch-preview-container'); c.innerHTML = '';
        if (!input.files) return;
        Array.from(input.files).forEach((f, idx) => {
            const r = new FileReader();
            r.onload = e => {
                const d = document.createElement('div');
                d.className = "bg-black/60 border border-white/10 rounded-xl p-2 flex flex-col items-center gap-1";
                d.innerHTML = `
                    <img src="${e.target.result}" class="w-16 h-16 object-contain rounded-lg">
                    <input type="text" name="figure_names" value="${f.name.split('.')[0]}" class="w-full bg-stone-900 border border-white/20 rounded px-1.5 py-1 text-[8px] text-white">
                    <label class="flex items-center gap-1 text-[7px] text-amber-300 font-bold"><input type="checkbox" name="is_secret_index" value="${idx}"> Chase ⭐</label>
                `;
                c.appendChild(d);
            };
            r.readAsDataURL(f);
        });
    }

    function previewAddFigures(input) {
        const c = document.getElementById('add-figure-preview-container'); c.innerHTML = '';
        if (!input.files) return;
        Array.from(input.files).forEach((f, idx) => {
            const r = new FileReader();
            r.onload = e => {
                const d = document.createElement('div');
                d.className = "bg-black/60 border border-white/10 rounded-xl p-2 flex flex-col items-center gap-1";
                d.innerHTML = `
                    <img src="${e.target.result}" class="w-12 h-12 object-contain rounded-lg">
                    <input type="text" name="figure_names" value="${f.name.split('.')[0]}" class="w-full bg-stone-900 border border-white/20 rounded px-1 text-[8px] text-white">
                    <label class="flex items-center gap-1 text-[7px] text-amber-300 font-bold"><input type="checkbox" name="is_secret_index" value="${idx}"> Chase ⭐</label>
                `;
                c.appendChild(d);
            };
            r.readAsDataURL(f);
        });
    }

    async function pinFigureToProfile(id, name, imgUrl, seriesName) {
        const btn = document.getElementById(`btn-pin-fig-${id}`);
        const prevHtml = btn ? btn.innerHTML : '';
        if (btn) btn.innerHTML = `<span>⏳</span> <span>Actualizando Expositor...</span>`;

        try {
            const formData = new FormData();
            formData.append('type', 'figure');
            formData.append('id', id);
            formData.append('name', name);
            formData.append('image', imgUrl);
            formData.append('rarity', 'Pop Mart');
            formData.append('series', seriesName || 'Colección Real');

            let tgId = '{{ tg_id }}';
            try {
                if (window.Telegram && window.Telegram.WebApp && window.Telegram.WebApp.initDataUnsafe && window.Telegram.WebApp.initDataUnsafe.user) {
                    tgId = window.Telegram.WebApp.initDataUnsafe.user.id || tgId;
                }
            } catch(e) {}
            if (tgId) formData.append('tg_id', tgId);

            const csrfToken = document.querySelector('[name=csrfmiddlewaretoken]')?.value 
                || (document.cookie.match(/csrftoken=([^;]+)/) || [])[1] 
                || '';
            formData.append('csrfmiddlewaretoken', csrfToken);

            const resp = await fetch('/profile/pin-item/', {
                method: 'POST',
                body: formData,
                headers: { 
                    'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest',
                    'X-CSRFToken': csrfToken
                }
            });

            const data = await resp.json();
            if (data.success) {
                try { window.Telegram?.WebApp?.HapticFeedback?.notificationOccurred('success'); } catch(e) {}
                if (btn) {
                    if (data.is_pinned) {
                        btn.innerHTML = `<span>✅</span> <span>Fijada en Perfil (Desanclar)</span>`;
                    } else {
                        btn.innerHTML = `<span>📌</span> <span>Fijar en Expositor de Mi Perfil</span>`;
                    }
                }
                alert(data.message);
            } else {
                alert(data.error || 'No se pudo actualizar el expositor.');
                if (btn) btn.innerHTML = prevHtml;
            }
        } catch (e) {
            console.error(e);
            alert('Error al conectar con la corte real.');
            if (btn) btn.innerHTML = prevHtml;
        }
    }
</script>

<script>
    const AudioCtx = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
    let audioCtx = null;

    function getAudioCtx() {
        if (!audioCtx) audioCtx = new AudioCtx();
        if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
        return audioCtx;
    }

    // Sonido de naipe deslizándose en el paño
    function playCardSound() {
        try {
            const ctx = getAudioCtx();
            const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
            const gain = ctx.createGain();
            osc.type = 'sine';
            osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(450, ctx.currentTime);
            osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(150, ctx.currentTime + 0.09);
            gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.3, ctx.currentTime);
            gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.01, ctx.currentTime + 0.09);
            osc.connect(gain);
            gain.connect(ctx.destination);
            osc.start();
            osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + 0.09);
        } catch(e) {}
    }

    // Tintineo de monedas
    function playCoins() {
        try {
            const ctx = getAudioCtx();
            [987, 1318, 1567, 2093].forEach((freq, idx) => {
                const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
                const gain = ctx.createGain();
                osc.type = 'sine';
                osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, ctx.currentTime + (idx * 0.08));
                gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.3, ctx.currentTime + (idx * 0.08));
                gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, ctx.currentTime + (idx * 0.08) + 0.25);
                osc.connect(gain);
                gain.connect(ctx.destination);
                osc.start(ctx.currentTime + (idx * 0.08));
                osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + (idx * 0.08) + 0.25);
            });
        } catch(e) {}
    }
</script>

<script>
    function setBJBet(val) {
        document.getElementById('bj_bet_input').value = val;
    }

    function renderCardHTML(c) {
        if (c.hidden) {
            return `
            <div class="card-deal w-14 h-20 rounded-xl shadow-2xl border-2 border-yellow-500/70 bg-gradient-to-br from-[#4a0815] via-[#850d24] to-[#2b040b] flex flex-col items-center justify-center relative select-none animate-pulse">
                <div class="w-10 h-16 border border-yellow-500/40 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center">
                    <span class="text-base text-yellow-300 drop-shadow">👑</span>
                </div>
            </div>`;
        }
        const colorClass = c.is_red ? 'text-rose-600' : 'text-neutral-900';
        return `
        <div class="card-deal w-14 h-20 bg-white rounded-xl shadow-2xl border border-neutral-300 flex flex-col justify-between p-1.5 select-none relative">
            <div class="flex justify-between items-center text-[11px] font-black leading-none ${colorClass}">
                <span>${c.val}</span><span>${c.suit}</span>
            </div>
            <div class="text-2xl self-center leading-none filter drop-shadow ${colorClass}">
                ${c.suit}
            </div>
            <div class="flex justify-between items-center text-[11px] font-black leading-none rotate-180 ${colorClass}">
                <span>${c.val}</span><span>${c.suit}</span>
            </div>
        </div>`;
    }

    async function handleBJAction(action) {
        playCardSound();
        try { window.Telegram?.WebApp?.HapticFeedback?.impactOccurred('medium'); } catch(e) {}

        const betVal = parseInt(document.getElementById('bj_bet_input').value, 10);
        const tgId = (typeof window.getGlobalTgId === 'function') ? window.getGlobalTgId() : '{{ tg_id }}';
        
        const formData = new FormData();
        formData.append('tg_id', tgId);
        formData.append('action', action);
        formData.append('bet_amount', betVal);
        formData.append('ajax', '1');
        formData.append('csrfmiddlewaretoken', '{{ csrf_token }}');

        try {
            const resp = await fetch("{% url 'economy:blackjack' %}", {
                method: 'POST',
                body: formData,
                headers: { 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest' }
            });
            const data = await resp.json();

            if (!data.success) {
                if (window.showVipAlert) {
                    showVipAlert(data.error, "Regla de la Corte", "⚠️");
                } else {
                    alert(data.error);
                }
                return;
            }

            // Actualizar Saldo
            const balanceElem = document.getElementById('bj-balance');
            if (balanceElem) balanceElem.innerText = data.nuevo_saldo;

            // Renderizar cartas Jugador
            const pCont = document.getElementById('player-cards-container');
            pCont.innerHTML = data.player_cards.map(c => renderCardHTML(c)).join('');

            // Renderizar cartas Croupier
            const dCont = document.getElementById('dealer-cards-container');
            dCont.innerHTML = data.dealer_cards.map(c => renderCardHTML(c)).join('');

            // Puntuaciones
            document.getElementById('player-score-badge').innerText = `${data.player_score} pts`;
            document.getElementById('dealer-score-badge').innerText = `${data.dealer_score} pts`;

            // Alternar controles
            const inGameControls = document.getElementById('ingame-controls');
            const betControls = document.getElementById('bet-controls');
            const resultBox = document.getElementById('bj-result-box');

            if (data.in_game) {
                inGameControls.classList.remove('hidden');
                betControls.classList.add('hidden');
                resultBox.innerHTML = '';
            } else {
                inGameControls.classList.add('hidden');
                betControls.classList.remove('hidden');

                // ─── EVALUACIÓN VISUAL DE RESULTADOS ───
                if (data.resultado === 'blackjack') {
                    playCoins();
                    try { window.Telegram?.WebApp?.HapticFeedback?.notificationOccurred('success'); } catch(e) {}
                    resultBox.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="p-3 bg-gradient-to-r from-yellow-600 via-amber-300 to-yellow-600 text-stone-950 text-xs font-black uppercase rounded-xl text-center shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(234,179,8,0.7)] tracking-wider animate-bounce">
                        👑 ¡BLACKJACK REAL! Pago x2.5 (+${data.ganancia} 🪙)
                    </div>`;
                } else if (data.resultado === 'win') {
                    playCoins();
                    try { window.Telegram?.WebApp?.HapticFeedback?.notificationOccurred('success'); } catch(e) {}
                    resultBox.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="p-2.5 bg-emerald-950/90 border-2 border-emerald-500 text-emerald-200 text-xs font-bold rounded-xl text-center shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(16,185,129,0.5)]">
                        🎉 ¡Victoria Noble! Superaste al Croupier (+${data.ganancia} 🪙).
                    </div>`;
                } else if (data.resultado === 'wolf_saved') {
                    playCoins();
                    try { window.Telegram?.WebApp?.HapticFeedback?.notificationOccurred('success'); } catch(e) {}
                    resultBox.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="p-2.5 bg-cyan-950/95 border-2 border-cyan-400 text-cyan-200 text-xs font-bold rounded-xl text-center shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(34,211,238,0.6)] animate-pulse">
                        🐺 ¡Tu Lobo Espectral intervino en las sombras! Recuperas tu apuesta de ${data.ganancia} 🪙.
                    </div>`;
                } else if (data.resultado === 'push') {
                    resultBox.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="p-2.5 bg-amber-950/90 border-2 border-amber-500 text-amber-200 text-xs font-bold rounded-xl text-center shadow">
                        🤝 Empate. Se reintegra tu apuesta de ${data.ganancia} 🪙.
                    </div>`;
                } else if (data.resultado === 'bust') {
                    try { window.Telegram?.WebApp?.HapticFeedback?.notificationOccurred('error'); } catch(e) {}
                    resultBox.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="p-2.5 bg-rose-950/90 border-2 border-rose-600 text-rose-200 text-xs font-bold rounded-xl text-center shadow">
                        💥 Te pasaste de 21 puntos. Pierdes ${data.ganancia} 🪙 de oro.
                    </div>`;
                } else if (data.resultado === 'lose') {
                    try { window.Telegram?.WebApp?.HapticFeedback?.notificationOccurred('error'); } catch(e) {}
                    resultBox.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="p-2.5 bg-rose-950/90 border-2 border-rose-600 text-rose-200 text-xs font-bold rounded-xl text-center shadow">
                        💀 El Croupier gana esta mano. Pierdes ${data.ganancia} 🪙 de oro.
                    </div>`;
                }
            }

        } catch(e) {
            alert("Error de conexión al jugar.");
        }
    }
</script>

<script>
    const AudioCtx = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
    let audioCtx = null;

    function getAudioCtx() {
        if (!audioCtx) audioCtx = new AudioCtx();
        if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
        return audioCtx;
    }

    function playTickSound() {
        try {
            const ctx = getAudioCtx();
            const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
            const gain = ctx.createGain();
            osc.type = 'triangle';
            osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(380, ctx.currentTime);
            osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(100, ctx.currentTime + 0.035);
            gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.2, ctx.currentTime);
            gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.01, ctx.currentTime + 0.035);
            osc.connect(gain);
            gain.connect(ctx.destination);
            osc.start();
            osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + 0.035);
        } catch(e) {}
    }

    function playCoins() {
        try {
            const ctx = getAudioCtx();
            [987, 1318, 1567, 2093].forEach((freq, idx) => {
                const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
                const gain = ctx.createGain();
                osc.type = 'sine';
                osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, ctx.currentTime + (idx * 0.08));
                gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.3, ctx.currentTime + (idx * 0.08));
                gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, ctx.currentTime + (idx * 0.08) + 0.25);
                osc.connect(gain);
                gain.connect(ctx.destination);
                osc.start(ctx.currentTime + (idx * 0.08));
                osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + (idx * 0.08) + 0.25);
            });
        } catch(e) {}
    }
</script>

<!-- RENDERIZADO HD Y FÍSICA EXACTA DE LA RULETA -->
<script>
    const ROULETTE_ORDER = [
        0, 32, 15, 19, 4, 21, 2, 25, 17, 34, 6, 27, 13, 36, 11, 30, 8, 23, 10, 5, 24, 16, 33, 1, 20, 14, 31, 9, 22, 18, 29, 7, 28, 12, 35, 3, 26
    ];

    const RED_NUMBERS = [1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 12, 14, 16, 18, 19, 21, 23, 25, 27, 30, 32, 34, 36];

    let currentRotation = 0;
    let isSpinning = false;

    function drawRouletteWheel() {
        const canvas = document.getElementById('roulette-canvas');
        if (!canvas) return;
        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        const cx = canvas.width / 2;
        const cy = canvas.height / 2;
        const radius = cx - 2;
        const sliceAngle = (2 * Math.PI) / 37;

        ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

        let startAngle = -Math.PI / 2 - (sliceAngle / 2);

        for (let i = 0; i < 37; i++) {
            const num = ROULETTE_ORDER[i];
            const endAngle = startAngle + sliceAngle;

            let color = '#151515';
            if (num === 0) color = '#15803d';
            else if (RED_NUMBERS.includes(num)) color = '#dc2626';

            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(cx, cy);
            ctx.arc(cx, cy, radius, startAngle, endAngle);
            ctx.closePath();
            ctx.fillStyle = color;
            ctx.fill();

            ctx.strokeStyle = '#d4af37';
            ctx.lineWidth = 1;
            ctx.stroke();

            ctx.save();
            ctx.translate(cx, cy);
            ctx.rotate(startAngle + sliceAngle / 2);
            ctx.textAlign = 'right';
            ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
            ctx.font = 'bold 9px monospace';
            ctx.fillText(num.toString(), radius - 8, 3.5);
            ctx.restore();

            startAngle = endAngle;
        }
    }

    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
        drawRouletteWheel();
    });

    function selectChoice(choice) {
        if (isSpinning) return;
        document.getElementById('bet_choice_input').value = choice;
        document.querySelectorAll('.choice-btn').forEach(b => {
            b.classList.remove('border-2', 'border-yellow-400', 'scale-105', 'shadow-lg');
        });
        const active = document.getElementById(`btn-choice-${choice}`);
        if (active) active.classList.add('border-2', 'border-yellow-400', 'scale-105', 'shadow-lg');
    }

    function selectNumberChoice() {
        const val = document.getElementById('target_number_input').value;
        if (val === '' || val < 0 || val > 36) {
            alert("Ingresa un número entre 0 y 36.");
            return;
        }
        selectChoice('number');
    }

    function setBet(amount) {
        if (!isSpinning) document.getElementById('bet_amount_input').value = amount;
    }

    async function startRouletteSpin() {
        if (isSpinning) return;

        const betAmount = parseInt(document.getElementById('bet_amount_input').value, 10);
        const betChoice = document.getElementById('bet_choice_input').value;
        const btn = document.getElementById('roulette-spin-btn');
        const canvas = document.getElementById('roulette-canvas');
        const resultBox = document.getElementById('roulette-result-box');
        const centerNum = document.getElementById('center-display-num');
        const centerText = document.getElementById('center-display-text');
        const balanceElem = document.getElementById('top-user-balance');

        if (!betAmount || betAmount <= 0) {
            resultBox.innerHTML = '<span class="text-xs text-rose-400 font-bold">⚠️ Ingresa una apuesta válida</span>';
            return;
        }

        const tgId = (typeof window.getGlobalTgId === 'function') ? window.getGlobalTgId() : '{{ tg_id }}';
        const formData = new FormData();
        formData.append('tg_id', tgId);
        formData.append('bet_amount', betAmount);
        formData.append('bet_choice', betChoice);
        // 🎯 TARGET NUMBER ENVIADO CORRECTAMENTE:
        formData.append('target_number', document.getElementById('target_number_input')?.value || '-1');
        formData.append('ajax', '1');
        formData.append('csrfmiddlewaretoken', '{{ csrf_token }}');

        isSpinning = true;
        btn.disabled = true;
        btn.classList.add('opacity-50');
        btn.innerHTML = '<span>⏳</span> Girando la Ruleta...';

        resultBox.innerHTML = '<span class="text-xs text-yellow-300 font-bold animate-pulse">La bola rueda sobre la ruleta...</span>';
        try { window.Telegram?.WebApp?.HapticFeedback?.impactOccurred('heavy'); } catch(e) {}

        try {
            const response = await fetch("{% url 'economy:casino' %}", {
                method: 'POST',
                body: formData,
                headers: { 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest' }
            });
            const data = await response.json();

            if (!data.success) {
                isSpinning = false;
                btn.disabled = false;
                btn.classList.remove('opacity-50');
                btn.innerHTML = '<span>🎡</span> Girar Ruleta Imperial';
                resultBox.innerHTML = `<span class="text-xs text-rose-400 font-bold">❌ ${data.error}</span>`;
                return;
            }

            const winningNum = data.numero_ganador;
            const winningIndex = ROULETTE_ORDER.indexOf(winningNum);
            const sliceDeg = 360 / 37;

            const slotTargetDeg = (360 - (winningIndex * sliceDeg)) % 360;
            const fullSpins = 2160;
            const currentMod = currentRotation % 360;
            const delta = (slotTargetDeg - currentMod + 360) % 360;
            const nextRotation = currentRotation + fullSpins + delta;

            currentRotation = nextRotation;

            canvas.style.transition = 'transform 3.6s cubic-bezier(0.12, 0.88, 0.22, 1)';
            canvas.style.transform = `rotate(${nextRotation}deg)`;

            let ticks = 0;
            const tickInt = setInterval(() => {
                playTickSound();
                try { window.Telegram?.WebApp?.HapticFeedback?.impactOccurred('light'); } catch(e) {}
                ticks++;
                if (ticks > 12) clearInterval(tickInt);
            }, 260);

            setTimeout(() => {
                clearInterval(tickInt);
                isSpinning = false;
                btn.disabled = false;
                btn.classList.remove('opacity-50');
                btn.innerHTML = '<span>🎡</span> Girar Ruleta Imperial';

                centerNum.innerText = winningNum;
                if (data.color_ganador === 'red') {
                    centerText.innerText = "ROJO";
                    centerText.className = "text-[8.5px] uppercase font-black text-rose-400 tracking-widest mt-0.5";
                } else if (data.color_ganador === 'black') {
                    centerText.innerText = "NEGRO";
                    centerText.className = "text-[8.5px] uppercase font-black text-stone-300 tracking-widest mt-0.5";
                } else {
                    centerText.innerText = "CERO";
                    centerText.className = "text-[8.5px] uppercase font-black text-emerald-400 tracking-widest mt-0.5";
                }

                if (balanceElem) balanceElem.innerText = data.nuevo_saldo;

                if (data.resultado === 'win') {
                    playCoins();
                    resultBox.innerHTML = `
                        <div class="p-2.5 bg-emerald-950/90 border border-emerald-500 rounded-2xl text-emerald-200 text-xs font-bold w-full animate-bounce shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(16,185,129,0.4)]">
                            🎉 ¡Acertaste! Cayó el ${winningNum} (${centerText.innerText}). Ganaste +${data.ganancia} 🪙.
                        </div>`;
                    try { window.Telegram?.WebApp?.HapticFeedback?.notificationOccurred('success'); } catch(e) {}
                } else {
                    resultBox.innerHTML = `
                        <div class="p-2.5 bg-rose-950/80 border border-rose-500 rounded-2xl text-rose-200 text-xs font-bold w-full shadow">
                            💀 Salió el ${winningNum} (${centerText.innerText}). Pierdes ${betAmount} 🪙 de oro.
                        </div>`;
                    try { window.Telegram?.WebApp?.HapticFeedback?.notificationOccurred('error'); } catch(e) {}
                }

            }, 3650);

        } catch(err) {
            isSpinning = false;
            btn.disabled = false;
            btn.classList.remove('opacity-50');
            btn.innerHTML = '<span>🎡</span> Girar Ruleta Imperial';
            resultBox.innerHTML = '<span class="text-xs text-rose-400 font-bold">⚠️ Error de conexión al girar</span>';
        }
    }
</script>
{% endblock %}

<script>
    function switchTab(tab) {
        const myRoleTab = document.getElementById('tab-my-role');
        const otherRoleTab = document.getElementById('tab-other-role');
        const myRoleContent = document.getElementById('content-my-role');
        const otherRoleContent = document.getElementById('content-other-role');

        if (tab === 'my_role') {
            myRoleTab.classList.add('border-rose-500', 'text-rose-400');
            myRoleTab.classList.remove('border-transparent', 'text-neutral-400');
            otherRoleTab.classList.add('border-transparent', 'text-neutral-400');
            otherRoleTab.classList.remove('border-rose-500', 'text-rose-400');
            myRoleContent.classList.remove('hidden');
            otherRoleContent.classList.add('hidden');
        } else {
            otherRoleTab.classList.add('border-rose-500', 'text-rose-400');
            otherRoleTab.classList.remove('border-transparent', 'text-neutral-400');
            myRoleTab.classList.add('border-transparent', 'text-neutral-400');
            myRoleTab.classList.remove('border-rose-500', 'text-rose-400');
            otherRoleContent.classList.remove('hidden');
            myRoleContent.classList.add('hidden');
        }
    }

    {% if active_job and not is_completed %}
    let secondsLeft = {{ time_remaining_seconds|default:0 }};
    const countdownEl = document.getElementById('countdown');

    function updateTimer() {
        if (!countdownEl) return;
        if (secondsLeft <= 0) {
            countdownEl.innerHTML = '<span class="text-emerald-400 font-bold">¡Finalizado! Recargando...</span>';
            setTimeout(() => {
                window.location.reload();
            }, 1200);
            return;
        }

        const hrs = Math.floor(secondsLeft / 3600);
        const mins = Math.floor((secondsLeft % 3600) / 60);
        const secs = secondsLeft % 60;

        let str = '';
        if (hrs > 0) str += `${hrs}h `;
        str += `${mins < 10 ? '0' : ''}${mins}m ${secs < 10 ? '0' : ''}${secs}s`;

        countdownEl.innerText = str;
        secondsLeft--;
    }

    updateTimer();
    setInterval(updateTimer, 1000);
    {% endif %}
</script>
{% endblock %}

<script>
    const AudioCtx = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
    let minesAudioCtx = null;

    function getAudioCtx() {
        if (!minesAudioCtx) minesAudioCtx = new AudioCtx();
        if (minesAudioCtx.state === 'suspended') minesAudioCtx.resume();
        return minesAudioCtx;
    }

    function playGemSound(pitchStep = 0) {
        try {
            const ctx = getAudioCtx();
            const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
            const gain = ctx.createGain();
            osc.type = 'sine';
            const baseFreq = 880 + (pitchStep * 60);
            osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(baseFreq, ctx.currentTime);
            osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(baseFreq * 1.5, ctx.currentTime + 0.15);
            gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.3, ctx.currentTime);
            gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, ctx.currentTime + 0.25);
            osc.connect(gain);
            gain.connect(ctx.destination);
            osc.start();
            osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + 0.25);
        } catch(e) {}
    }

    function playBombSound() {
        try {
            const ctx = getAudioCtx();
            const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
            const gain = ctx.createGain();
            osc.type = 'sawtooth';
            osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(140, ctx.currentTime);
            osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(30, ctx.currentTime + 0.35);
            gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.4, ctx.currentTime);
            gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.01, ctx.currentTime + 0.35);
            osc.connect(gain);
            gain.connect(ctx.destination);
            osc.start();
            osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + 0.35);
        } catch(e) {}
    }

    function playCoins() {
        try {
            const ctx = getAudioCtx();
            [987, 1318, 1567, 2093].forEach((freq, idx) => {
                const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
                const gain = ctx.createGain();
                osc.type = 'sine';
                osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, ctx.currentTime + (idx * 0.08));
                gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.3, ctx.currentTime + (idx * 0.08));
                gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, ctx.currentTime + (idx * 0.08) + 0.25);
                osc.connect(gain);
                gain.connect(ctx.destination);
                osc.start(ctx.currentTime + (idx * 0.08));
                osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + (idx * 0.08) + 0.25);
            });
        } catch(e) {}
    }
</script>

<script>
    let isGameRunning = {{ in_game|yesno:'true,false' }};
    let revealedGems = {{ current_revealed|safe }};

    function setMinesCount(count) {
        if (isGameRunning) return;
        document.getElementById('selected-mines-count').value = count;
        [1, 3, 5, 10].forEach(c => {
            const btn = document.getElementById(`btn-m-${c}`);
            if (btn) {
                if (c === count) {
                    btn.className = "py-2 rounded-xl border-2 border-yellow-400 bg-yellow-500/20 text-xs font-mono font-bold text-yellow-300 shadow";
                } else {
                    btn.className = "py-2 rounded-xl border border-purple-500/40 bg-black/60 text-xs font-mono font-bold text-stone-300";
                }
            }
        });
    }

    function setBetAmount(val) {
        if (!isGameRunning) document.getElementById('mines-bet-input').value = val;
    }

    async function startMinesGame() {
        const betVal = parseInt(document.getElementById('mines-bet-input').value, 10);
        const minesCount = parseInt(document.getElementById('selected-mines-count').value, 10);
        const tgId = (typeof window.getGlobalTgId === 'function') ? window.getGlobalTgId() : '{{ tg_id }}';

        const formData = new FormData();
        formData.append('tg_id', tgId);
        formData.append('action', 'start');
        formData.append('bet_amount', betVal);
        formData.append('mines_count', minesCount);
        formData.append('ajax', '1');
        formData.append('csrfmiddlewaretoken', '{{ csrf_token }}');

        try {
            const resp = await fetch("{% url 'economy:mines' %}", {
                method: 'POST',
                body: formData,
                headers: { 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest' }
            });
            const data = await resp.json();

            if (!data.success) {
                if (window.showVipAlert) {
                    showVipAlert(data.error, "Tope de Apuesta", "🪙");
                } else {
                    alert(data.error);
                }
                return;
            } 
            
            isGameRunning = true;
            revealedGems = [];

            // Actualizar saldo
            document.getElementById('mines-balance').innerText = data.nuevo_saldo;

            // Resetear casilleros visualmente
            for (let i = 0; i < 25; i++) {
                const tile = document.getElementById(`tile-${i}`);
                const hiddenCover = tile.querySelector('.tile-hidden');
                tile.className = "mine-tile relative rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-br from-[#281340] to-[#120520] border border-vip-gold/30 flex items-center justify-center text-xl shadow hover:border-vip-gold active:scale-95 transition-all aspect-square select-none";
                hiddenCover.classList.remove('hidden');
                tile.querySelector('.tile-icon').innerText = '💎';
            }

            document.getElementById('mult-val').innerText = '1.00';
            document.getElementById('cashout-val').innerText = data.bet;
            document.getElementById('cashout-btn').classList.add('hidden');
            document.getElementById('status-tag').classList.remove('hidden');
            document.getElementById('status-label').innerText = 'En juego';
            document.getElementById('mines-setup-controls').classList.add('hidden');
            document.getElementById('mines-result-box').innerHTML = '<span class="text-xs text-yellow-300 font-bold animate-pulse">¡Ronda iniciada! Toca un cofre...</span>';

            try { window.Telegram?.WebApp?.HapticFeedback?.impactOccurred('medium'); } catch(e) {}

        } catch(e) {
            if (window.showVipAlert) {
                showVipAlert("Error de conexión al iniciar la ronda.", "Conexión", "⚠️");
            } else {
                alert("Error de conexión al iniciar.");
            }
        }
    }

    async function revealTile(index) {
        if (!isGameRunning || revealedGems.includes(index)) return;

        const tgId = (typeof window.getGlobalTgId === 'function') ? window.getGlobalTgId() : '{{ tg_id }}';
        const formData = new FormData();
        formData.append('tg_id', tgId);
        formData.append('action', 'reveal');
        formData.append('tile_index', index);
        formData.append('ajax', '1');
        formData.append('csrfmiddlewaretoken', '{{ csrf_token }}');

        try {
            const resp = await fetch("{% url 'economy:mines' %}", {
                method: 'POST',
                body: formData,
                headers: { 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest' }
            });
            const data = await resp.json();

            if (!data.success) return;

            const tile = document.getElementById(`tile-${index}`);
            const hiddenCover = tile.querySelector('.tile-hidden');

            if (data.status === 'bust') {
                playBombSound();
                try { window.Telegram?.WebApp?.HapticFeedback?.notificationOccurred('error'); } catch(e) {}
                isGameRunning = false;

                hiddenCover.classList.add('hidden');
                tile.className = "mine-tile relative rounded-xl bg-red-600 border-2 border-red-300 flex items-center justify-center text-2xl shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(239,68,68,0.8)] animate-bounce";
                tile.querySelector('.tile-icon').innerText = '💣';

                data.all_mines.forEach(mIdx => {
                    const mTile = document.getElementById(`tile-${mIdx}`);
                    mTile.querySelector('.tile-hidden').classList.add('hidden');
                    mTile.className = "mine-tile relative rounded-xl bg-neutral-900 border border-red-500/50 flex items-center justify-center text-lg";
                    mTile.querySelector('.tile-icon').innerText = '💣';
                });

                document.getElementById('mines-result-box').innerHTML = `
                    <div class="p-2 bg-rose-950/90 border border-rose-600 text-rose-200 text-xs font-bold rounded-xl w-full">
                        💥 ¡BOOM! Has tocado una mina. Pierdes la apuesta.
                    </div>`;

                document.getElementById('cashout-btn').classList.add('hidden');
                document.getElementById('status-tag').classList.remove('hidden');
                document.getElementById('status-label').innerText = 'Derrota';
                document.getElementById('mines-setup-controls').classList.remove('hidden');

            } else {
                revealedGems.push(index);
                playGemSound(revealedGems.length);
                try { window.Telegram?.WebApp?.HapticFeedback?.impactOccurred('light'); } catch(e) {}

                hiddenCover.classList.add('hidden');
                tile.className = "mine-tile relative rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-br from-emerald-600 to-green-950 border-2 border-emerald-400 flex items-center justify-center text-2xl shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(16,185,129,0.6)]";
                tile.querySelector('.tile-icon').innerText = '💎';

                document.getElementById('mult-val').innerText = Number(data.multiplier).toFixed(2);
                document.getElementById('cashout-val').innerText = data.current_cashout;

                if (data.status === 'win_full') {
                    playCoins();
                    isGameRunning = false;
                    document.getElementById('mines-balance').innerText = data.nuevo_saldo;
                    document.getElementById('mines-result-box').innerHTML = `
                        <div class="p-2 bg-gradient-to-r from-yellow-500 to-amber-500 text-black text-xs font-black uppercase rounded-xl w-full animate-bounce">
                            👑 ¡PERFECTO! Limpiaste todas las gemas (+${data.current_cashout} 🪙).
                        </div>`;
                    document.getElementById('cashout-btn').classList.add('hidden');
                    document.getElementById('mines-setup-controls').classList.remove('hidden');
                } else {
                    document.getElementById('cashout-btn').classList.remove('hidden');
                    document.getElementById('status-tag').classList.add('hidden');
                }
            }

        } catch(e) {
            console.error(e);
        }
    }

    async function cashoutMines() {
        if (!isGameRunning) return;

        const tgId = (typeof window.getGlobalTgId === 'function') ? window.getGlobalTgId() : '{{ tg_id }}';
        const formData = new FormData();
        formData.append('tg_id', tgId);
        formData.append('action', 'cashout');
        formData.append('ajax', '1');
        formData.append('csrfmiddlewaretoken', '{{ csrf_token }}');

        try {
            const resp = await fetch("{% url 'economy:mines' %}", {
                method: 'POST',
                body: formData,
                headers: { 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest' }
            });
            const data = await resp.json();

            if (!data.success) return;

            isGameRunning = false;
            playCoins(); // 👈 Tintineo de monedas
            playWinFanfare(); // 👈 Fanfarria noble
            try { window.Telegram?.WebApp?.HapticFeedback?.notificationOccurred('success'); } catch(e) {}

            document.getElementById('mines-balance').innerText = data.nuevo_saldo;

            data.all_mines.forEach(mIdx => {
                const mTile = document.getElementById(`tile-${mIdx}`);
                mTile.querySelector('.tile-hidden').classList.add('hidden');
                mTile.className = "mine-tile relative rounded-xl bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-700 flex items-center justify-center text-sm opacity-50";
                mTile.querySelector('.tile-icon').innerText = '💣';
            });

            document.getElementById('cashout-btn').classList.add('hidden');
            document.getElementById('status-tag').classList.remove('hidden');
            document.getElementById('status-label').innerText = 'Retirado';

            document.getElementById('mines-result-box').innerHTML = `
                <div class="p-2.5 bg-emerald-950/90 border border-emerald-500 text-emerald-200 text-xs font-bold rounded-xl w-full shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(16,185,129,0.4)] animate-bounce">
                    🎉 ¡Te retiraste con éxito! Has cobrado +${data.ganancia} 🪙 (x${Number(data.multiplier).toFixed(2)}).
                </div>`;

            document.getElementById('mines-setup-controls').classList.remove('hidden');

        } catch(e) {
            console.error(e);
        }
    }

    function playWinFanfare() {
        try {
            const ctx = getAudioCtx();
            const notes = [523.25, 659.25, 783.99, 1046.50]; // Acorde Mayor triunfal Do-Mi-Sol-Do
            notes.forEach((freq, idx) => {
                const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
                const gain = ctx.createGain();
                osc.type = 'triangle';
                osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, ctx.currentTime + (idx * 0.09));
                gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.25, ctx.currentTime + (idx * 0.09));
                gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, ctx.currentTime + (idx * 0.09) + 0.35);
                osc.connect(gain);
                gain.connect(ctx.destination);
                osc.start(ctx.currentTime + (idx * 0.09));
                osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + (idx * 0.09) + 0.35);
            });
        } catch(e) {}
    }
</script>
{% endblock %}
