<script>
    const userLevel = {{ profile.level|default:1 }};
    const tierCosts = { 'bronze': 25, 'silver': 60, 'gold': 150 };
    const tierNames = { 'bronze': 'Cartón de Bronce', 'silver': 'Cartón de Plata', 'gold': 'Cartón Imperial de Oro' };
    
    // Seleccionar automáticamente el tier más alto que el usuario puede jugar
    let activeTier = (userLevel >= 5) ? 'gold' : ((userLevel >= 3) ? 'silver' : 'bronze');

    let isDrawing = false;
    let lastPos = null;
    let canvas, ctx;
    let ticketActive = false;
    let currentTicketData = null;
    let totalPixels = 0;
    let audioCtx = null;
    let currentDisplayedBalance = parseInt(document.getElementById('user-balance').innerText) || 0;
    let progressCheckTimeout = null;

function playScratchSound() {
        try {
            if (!audioCtx) audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
            if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
            const bufferSize = audioCtx.sampleRate * 0.04;
            const buffer = audioCtx.createBuffer(1, bufferSize, audioCtx.sampleRate);
            const data = buffer.getChannelData(0);
            for (let i = 0; i < bufferSize; i++) {
                data[i] = Math.random() * 2 - 1;
            }
            const noise = audioCtx.createBufferSource();
            noise.buffer = buffer;
            const filter = audioCtx.createBiquadFilter();
            filter.type = 'bandpass';
            filter.frequency.value = 2000 + Math.random() * 800;
            filter.Q.value = 2.5;
            const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
            gain.gain.value = 0.06;
            noise.connect(filter);
            filter.connect(gain);
            gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
            noise.start();
        } catch(e) {}
    }

    function selectTier(tier) {
        activeTier = tier;
        ['bronze', 'silver', 'gold'].forEach(t => {
            const btn = document.getElementById(`btn-tier-${t}`);
            if (t === tier) {
                btn.classList.add('border-vip-gold', 'ring-2', 'ring-yellow-400/50');
            } else {
                btn.classList.remove('border-vip-gold', 'ring-2', 'ring-yellow-400/50');
            }
        });
        document.getElementById('ticket-cost-label').innerText = tierCosts[tier];
        document.getElementById('ticket-tier-name').innerText = tierNames[tier];
        document.getElementById('loss-retry-cost').innerText = tierCosts[tier];
        try { window.Telegram?.WebApp?.HapticFeedback?.selectionChanged(); } catch(e) {}
    }

    function initCanvasFoil() {
        canvas = document.getElementById('scratch-canvas');
        ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        totalPixels = canvas.width * canvas.height;
        ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';

        // Lámina de oro con degradado realista
        const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
        grad.addColorStop(0, '#785012');
        grad.addColorStop(0.2, '#d4af37');
        grad.addColorStop(0.45, '#fff6bd');
        grad.addColorStop(0.7, '#b8860b');
        grad.addColorStop(1, '#543807');
        ctx.fillStyle = grad;
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

        // Estampado de seguridad
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.18)';
        ctx.font = 'bold 12px serif';
        ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        ctx.fillText('👑 REINO DEL PLACER 👑', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 - 18);
        ctx.font = 'bold 10px monospace';
        ctx.fillText('✨ RASPA CON TU DEDO ✨', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 + 12);
    }

    async function purchaseTicket() {
        const btn = document.getElementById('btn-buy-ticket');
        btn.disabled = true;
        btn.innerHTML = '<span>⏳ Comprando...</span>';

        const formData = new FormData();
        formData.append('tier', activeTier);
        formData.append('csrfmiddlewaretoken', '{{ csrf_token }}');
        const tgId = (typeof window.getGlobalTgId === 'function') ? window.getGlobalTgId() : '{{ tg_id }}';
        formData.append('tg_id', tgId);

        try {
            const res = await fetch('/economy/scratch/play/', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest' },
                body: formData
            });
            const data = await res.json();
            
            if (!data.success) {
                alert(data.error || 'No se pudo comprar el cartón.');
                btn.disabled = false;
                btn.innerHTML = `Comprar Billete (${tierCosts[activeTier]} 🪙)`;
                return;
            }

            currentTicketData = data;

            // Saldo visual inicial
            currentDisplayedBalance = data.balance_after_cost !== undefined ? data.balance_after_cost : (currentDisplayedBalance - tierCosts[activeTier]);
            document.getElementById('user-balance').innerText = currentDisplayedBalance;
            document.getElementById('ticket-serial').innerText = `#${data.serial || '777'}`;

            // Llenar cuadrícula oculta (soporta tanto data.grid como data.cells)
            const gridContainer = document.getElementById('grid-container');
            gridContainer.innerHTML = '';
            const cellsList = data.grid || data.cells || [];
            
            cellsList.forEach(cell => {
                const cellEl = document.createElement('div');
                cellEl.className = `flex flex-col items-center justify-center rounded-xl p-1 bg-black/60 border border-white/10 ${cell.is_winner ? 'win-pulse-cell' : ''}`;
                cellEl.innerHTML = `
                    <span class="text-2xl">${cell.symbol}</span>
                    <span class="text-[7.5px] font-mono uppercase font-bold truncate mt-0.5" style="color: ${cell.color || '#fbbf24'};">${cell.name}</span>
                `;
                gridContainer.appendChild(cellEl);
            });

            // Preparar lámina de raspado
            initCanvasFoil();
            document.getElementById('buy-prompt-overlay').style.display = 'none';
            document.getElementById('loss-verdict-banner').style.display = 'none';
            document.getElementById('action-controls').style.display = 'flex';
            document.getElementById('scratch-percent').innerText = '0%';
            ticketActive = true;

            try { window.Telegram?.WebApp?.HapticFeedback?.impactOccurred('medium'); } catch(e) {}
        } catch(err) {
            console.error("Error al procesar raspe:", err);
            alert('Error al inicializar el cartón.');
            btn.disabled = false;
            btn.innerHTML = `Comprar Billete (${tierCosts[activeTier]} 🪙)`;
        }
    }

    // ✅ Trazado continuo suave (anti-círculos cortados)
    function scratchStroke(fromX, fromY, toX, toY) {
        if (!ticketActive) return;
        ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'destination-out';
        ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
        ctx.lineCap = 'round';
        ctx.lineWidth = 42;

        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(fromX, fromY);
        ctx.lineTo(toX, toY);
        ctx.stroke();

        playScratchSound();
        if (Math.random() < 0.25) {
            try { window.Telegram?.WebApp?.HapticFeedback?.impactOccurred('light'); } catch(e) {}
        }

        // Programar cálculo de porcentaje optimizado
        if (!progressCheckTimeout) {
            progressCheckTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
                checkScratchProgress();
                progressCheckTimeout = null;
            }, 80);
        }
    }

    function checkScratchProgress() {
        if (!ticketActive) return;
        const imgData = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
        let clearCount = 0;
        // Muestreo cada 16 bytes (1 de cada 4 píxeles)
        for (let i = 3; i < imgData.data.length; i += 16) {
            if (imgData.data[i] === 0) clearCount++;
        }
        const percent = Math.min(100, Math.round((clearCount / (totalPixels / 4)) * 100));
        document.getElementById('scratch-percent').innerText = `${percent}%`;

        if (percent >= 52) {
            autoRevealTicket();
        }
    }

    function autoRevealTicket() {
        if (!ticketActive) return;
        ticketActive = false;
        ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
        document.getElementById('scratch-percent').innerText = '100%';
        setTimeout(() => {
            finishTicketVerdict();
        }, 250);
    }

    function animateBalanceCount(start, end) {
        const el = document.getElementById('user-balance');
        const diff = end - start;
        const steps = 15;
        let currentStep = 0;
        const interval = setInterval(() => {
            currentStep++;
            const progress = currentStep / steps;
            const val = Math.round(start + diff * progress);
            el.innerText = val;
            if (currentStep >= steps) {
                clearInterval(interval);
                el.innerText = end;
            }
        }, 30);
    }

    function finishTicketVerdict() {
        if (!currentTicketData) return;
        document.getElementById('action-controls').style.display = 'none';

        if (currentTicketData.is_win) {
            try { window.Telegram?.WebApp?.HapticFeedback?.notificationOccurred('success'); } catch(e) {}
            
            // Efecto visual a las 3 celdas ganadoras
            document.querySelectorAll('.win-pulse-cell').forEach(c => {
                c.classList.add('ring-2', 'ring-yellow-400', 'bg-yellow-950/40', 'animate-pulse');
            });

            // Animación de saldo sumando el premio
            animateBalanceCount(currentDisplayedBalance, currentTicketData.new_balance);
            currentDisplayedBalance = currentTicketData.new_balance;

            document.getElementById('win-symbol-name').innerText = currentTicketData.winning_symbol;
            document.getElementById('win-payout-label').innerText = `+${currentTicketData.payout} 🪙`;
            
            if (currentTicketData.photocard_won) {
                const pc = currentTicketData.photocard_won;
                document.getElementById('win-photocard-name').innerText = pc.name;
                document.getElementById('win-photocard-idol').innerText = pc.idol;
                document.getElementById('win-photocard-img').src = pc.image || '';
                document.getElementById('win-photocard-box').classList.remove('hidden');
            } else {
                document.getElementById('win-photocard-box').classList.add('hidden');
            }
            
            setTimeout(() => {
                document.getElementById('win-modal').classList.remove('hidden');
            }, 400);

        } else {
            // ✅ Pérdida: NO tapamos el cartón, dejamos ver los símbolos y mostramos banner abajo
            try { window.Telegram?.WebApp?.HapticFeedback?.impactOccurred('medium'); } catch(e) {}
            document.getElementById('loss-verdict-banner').style.display = 'flex';
        }
    }

    function resetToBuyState() {
        document.getElementById('loss-verdict-banner').style.display = 'none';
        initCanvasFoil();
        document.getElementById('buy-prompt-overlay').style.display = 'flex';
        const btn = document.getElementById('btn-buy-ticket');
        btn.disabled = false;
        btn.innerHTML = `Comprar Billete (${tierCosts[activeTier]} 🪙)`;
    }

    function closeWinModalAndPlayAgain() {
        document.getElementById('win-modal').classList.add('hidden');
        resetToBuyState();
    }

    // ✅ Listeners con soporte táctil hermético (bloquea scroll móvil en el canvas)
    window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
        initCanvasFoil();
        selectTier(activeTier);

        const getPos = (e) => {
            const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
            let clientX, clientY;
            if (e.touches && e.touches.length > 0) {
                clientX = e.touches[0].clientX;
                clientY = e.touches[0].clientY;
            } else {
                clientX = e.clientX;
                clientY = e.clientY;
            }
            return {
                x: (clientX - rect.left) * (canvas.width / rect.width),
                y: (clientY - rect.top) * (canvas.height / rect.height)
            };
        };

        const onStart = (e) => {
            if (!ticketActive) return;
            isDrawing = true;
            lastPos = getPos(e);
            scratchStroke(lastPos.x, lastPos.y, lastPos.x, lastPos.y);
        };

        const onMove = (e) => {
            if (!isDrawing || !ticketActive) return;
            const currentPos = getPos(e);
            if (lastPos) {
                scratchStroke(lastPos.x, lastPos.y, currentPos.x, currentPos.y);
            }
            lastPos = currentPos;
        };

        const onEnd = () => {
            if (isDrawing) {
                isDrawing = false;
                lastPos = null;
                checkScratchProgress();
            }
        };

        // Eventos de ratón
        canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', onStart);
        window.addEventListener('mousemove', onMove);
        window.addEventListener('mouseup', onEnd);

        // Eventos táctiles móviles (bloquean scroll con preventDefault)
        canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            onStart(e);
        }, { passive: false });

        canvas.addEventListener('touchmove', (e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            onMove(e);
        }, { passive: false });

        window.addEventListener('touchend', onEnd);
        window.addEventListener('touchcancel', onEnd);
    });
</script>
{% endblock %}

<script>
    const AudioCtx = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
    let audioCtx = null;

    function getAudioCtx() {
        if (!audioCtx) audioCtx = new AudioCtx();
        if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
        return audioCtx;
    }

    // Sonido de clic mecánico de rodillo
    function playClack() {
        try {
            const ctx = getAudioCtx();
            const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
            const gain = ctx.createGain();
            osc.type = 'triangle';
            osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(220, ctx.currentTime);
            osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(60, ctx.currentTime + 0.08);
            gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.5, ctx.currentTime);
            gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.01, ctx.currentTime + 0.08);
            osc.connect(gain);
            gain.connect(ctx.destination);
            osc.start();
            osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + 0.08);
        } catch(e) {}
    }

    // Sonido de tintineo de monedas de oro
    function playCoins() {
        try {
            const ctx = getAudioCtx();
            [987, 1318, 1567, 2093].forEach((freq, idx) => {
                const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
                const gain = ctx.createGain();
                osc.type = 'sine';
                osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, ctx.currentTime + (idx * 0.08));
                gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.3, ctx.currentTime + (idx * 0.08));
                gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, ctx.currentTime + (idx * 0.08) + 0.25);
                osc.connect(gain);
                gain.connect(ctx.destination);
                osc.start(ctx.currentTime + (idx * 0.08));
                osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + (idx * 0.08) + 0.25);
            });
        } catch(e) {}
    }
</script>

<style>
    .spinning-reel {
        animation: spinBlur 0.08s infinite linear;
        filter: blur(2px);
    }
    @keyframes spinBlur {
        0% { transform: translateY(-35px) scale(0.9); opacity: 0.5; }
        50% { transform: translateY(0px) scale(1.05); opacity: 1; }
        100% { transform: translateY(35px) scale(0.9); opacity: 0.5; }
    }
    .reel-stop {
        animation: stopBounce 0.28s ease-out;
    }
    @keyframes stopBounce {
        0% { transform: translateY(-25px); }

        100% { transform: translateY(0); }

<script>
    const SYMBOLS = ['👑', '💎', '⭐', '🍇', '🍒', '🪙'];
    let isSpinning = false;

    function setBet(val) {
        if (!isSpinning) document.getElementById('bet_amount_input').value = val;
    }

    async function spinSlots() {
        if (isSpinning) return;
        const betInput = document.getElementById('bet_amount_input');
        const betVal = parseInt(betInput.value, 10);
        const resultBox = document.getElementById('result-box');
        const btn = document.getElementById('spin-btn');
        const balanceElem = document.getElementById('slots-balance');

        if (!betVal || betVal <= 0) {
            resultBox.innerHTML = '<span class="text-xs text-red-400 font-bold">⚠️ Apuesta inválida</span>';
            return;
        }

        const tgId = (typeof window.getGlobalTgId === 'function') ? window.getGlobalTgId() : '{{ tg_id }}';
        const formData = new FormData();
        formData.append('tg_id', tgId);
        formData.append('bet_amount', betVal);
        formData.append('ajax', '1');
        formData.append('csrfmiddlewaretoken', '{{ csrf_token }}');

        isSpinning = true;
        btn.disabled = true;
        btn.classList.add('opacity-50');
        btn.innerHTML = '<span>⏳</span> Rodillos Girando...';

        resultBox.innerHTML = '<span class="text-xs text-yellow-300 font-bold animate-pulse">Rodillos a toda velocidad...</span>';

        const r1 = document.getElementById('reel-1');
        const r2 = document.getElementById('reel-2');
        const r3 = document.getElementById('reel-3');

        r1.classList.add('spinning-reel');
        r2.classList.add('spinning-reel');
        r3.classList.add('spinning-reel');

        try { window.Telegram?.WebApp?.HapticFeedback?.impactOccurred('heavy'); } catch(e) {}

        const int1 = setInterval(() => { r1.innerText = SYMBOLS[Math.floor(Math.random()*SYMBOLS.length)]; }, 70);
        const int2 = setInterval(() => { r2.innerText = SYMBOLS[Math.floor(Math.random()*SYMBOLS.length)]; }, 70);
        const int3 = setInterval(() => { r3.innerText = SYMBOLS[Math.floor(Math.random()*SYMBOLS.length)]; }, 70);

        try {
            const resp = await fetch("{% url 'economy:slots' %}", {
                method: 'POST',
                body: formData,
                headers: { 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest' }
            });
            const data = await resp.json();

            if (!data.success) {
                clearInterval(int1); clearInterval(int2); clearInterval(int3);
                r1.classList.remove('spinning-reel'); r2.classList.remove('spinning-reel'); r3.classList.remove('spinning-reel');
                isSpinning = false;
                btn.disabled = false;
                btn.classList.remove('opacity-50');
                btn.innerHTML = '<span>🎰</span> Bajar Palanca (Tirar)';
                resultBox.innerHTML = `<span class="text-xs text-red-400 font-bold">❌ ${data.error}</span>`;
                return;
            }

            // Freno 1: 0.6s
            setTimeout(() => {
                clearInterval(int1);
                r1.classList.remove('spinning-reel');
                r1.innerText = data.reels[0];
                r1.classList.add('reel-stop');
                playClack();
                try { window.Telegram?.WebApp?.HapticFeedback?.impactOccurred('medium'); } catch(e) {}
            }, 600);

            // Freno 2: 1.1s
            setTimeout(() => {
                clearInterval(int2);
                r2.classList.remove('spinning-reel');
                r2.innerText = data.reels[1];
                r2.classList.add('reel-stop');
                playClack();
                try { window.Telegram?.WebApp?.HapticFeedback?.impactOccurred('medium'); } catch(e) {}
            }, 1100);

            // Freno 3: 1.6s (Final)
            setTimeout(() => {
                clearInterval(int3);
                r3.classList.remove('spinning-reel');
                r3.innerText = data.reels[2];
                r3.classList.add('reel-stop');
                playClack();

                isSpinning = false;
                btn.disabled = false;
                btn.classList.remove('opacity-50');
                btn.innerHTML = '<span>🎰</span> Bajar Palanca (Tirar)';

                if (balanceElem) balanceElem.innerText = data.nuevo_saldo;

                if (data.resultado === 'jackpot') {
                    playCoins();
                    try { window.Telegram?.WebApp?.HapticFeedback?.notificationOccurred('success'); } catch(e) {}
                    resultBox.innerHTML = `
                        <div class="p-3 bg-gradient-to-r from-yellow-500 via-amber-300 to-yellow-500 border border-yellow-200 rounded-xl text-stone-950 text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider w-full animate-bounce shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(234,179,8,0.7)]">
                            👑 ¡JACKPOT IMPERIAL! Has ganado +${data.ganancia} 🪙 de oro.
                        </div>`;
                } else if (data.resultado === 'trio') {
                    playCoins();
                    try { window.Telegram?.WebApp?.HapticFeedback?.notificationOccurred('success'); } catch(e) {}
                    resultBox.innerHTML = `
                        <div class="p-2.5 bg-purple-950/90 border border-purple-400 rounded-xl text-purple-200 text-xs font-bold w-full shadow">
                            ✨ ¡Trío Conseguido! Cobras +${data.ganancia} 🪙.
                        </div>`;
                } else if (data.resultado === 'pair_premium') {
                    playCoins();
                    resultBox.innerHTML = `
                        <div class="p-2.5 bg-emerald-950/80 border border-emerald-500 rounded-xl text-emerald-200 text-xs font-bold w-full">
                            💎 ¡Par Noble! Ganancia neta (+${data.ganancia} 🪙).
                        </div>`;
                } else if (data.resultado === 'pair') {
                    resultBox.innerHTML = `
                        <div class="p-2.5 bg-amber-950/80 border border-amber-500/60 rounded-xl text-amber-200 text-xs font-bold w-full">
                            🍒 ¡Par conseguido! Recuperas tu apuesta (+${data.ganancia} 🪙).
                        </div>`;
                } else {
                    try { window.Telegram?.WebApp?.HapticFeedback?.notificationOccurred('error'); } catch(e) {}
                    resultBox.innerHTML = `
                        <div class="p-2.5 bg-rose-950/80 border border-rose-500 rounded-xl text-rose-200 text-xs font-bold w-full">
                            💀 Sin coincidencia. Pierdes ${betVal} 🪙 de oro.
                        </div>`;
                }

            }, 1600);

        } catch(e) {
            clearInterval(int1); clearInterval(int2); clearInterval(int3);
            isSpinning = false;
            btn.disabled = false;
            btn.classList.remove('opacity-50');
            btn.innerHTML = '<span>🎰</span> Bajar Palanca (Tirar)';
            resultBox.innerHTML = '<span class="text-xs text-red-400 font-bold">⚠️ Error de conexión</span>';
        }
    }
</script>
{% endblock %}

<script>
    async function claimPatronVault() {
        const btn = document.getElementById('btn-claim-vault');
        const tgId = (typeof window.getGlobalTgId === 'function') ? window.getGlobalTgId() : '{{ wallet.telegram_user_id }}';
        const formData = new FormData();
        formData.append('tg_id', tgId);
        formData.append('ajax', '1');
        formData.append('csrfmiddlewaretoken', '{{ csrf_token }}');

        btn.disabled = true;
        btn.innerHTML = '<span>⏳</span>';

        try {
            const resp = await fetch("{% url 'economy:claim_vault' %}", {
                method: 'POST',
                body: formData,
                headers: { 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest' }
            });
            const data = await resp.json();

            if (data.success) {
                try { window.Telegram?.WebApp?.HapticFeedback?.notificationOccurred('success'); } catch(e) {}
                document.getElementById('main-balance-text').innerText = data.nuevo_saldo;
                document.getElementById('vault-amount').innerText = '0';
                btn.className = "btn-gold py-2.5 px-4 rounded-xl text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider shadow opacity-40 cursor-not-allowed";
                btn.innerHTML = 'Cobrado';
                if (window.showVipAlert) {
                    showVipAlert(`¡Retiraste +${data.claimed} 🪙 de retorno a tu Bóveda!`, "Cofre del Mecenas", "🏺");
                }
            } else {
                btn.disabled = false;
                btn.innerHTML = 'Cobrar';
                alert(data.error);
            }
        } catch(e) {
            btn.disabled = false;
            btn.innerHTML = 'Cobrar';
        }
    }

    function spinDailyWheel() {
        const btn = document.getElementById('btn-spin-daily');
        const wheel = document.getElementById('daily-wheel');
        if (!btn || !wheel) return;

        btn.disabled = true;
        btn.innerHTML = '<span>⏳</span> Girando el Destino...';
        btn.classList.add('opacity-60');

        const degrees = 1800 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 360);
        wheel.style.transform = `rotate(${degrees}deg)`;

        setTimeout(() => {
            btn.innerHTML = '<span>🎉</span> ¡Premio Concedido! Guardando oro...';
            btn.classList.remove('opacity-60');
            btn.classList.add('bg-emerald-600', 'text-white');
            try { window.Telegram?.WebApp?.HapticFeedback?.notificationOccurred('success'); } catch(e) {}
            
            setTimeout(() => {
                document.getElementById('daily-wheel-form')?.submit();
            }, 1800);
        }, 3000);
    }

    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
        const rawSeconds = "{{ wallet.seconds_until_next_bonus|default:'0' }}";
        let remainingSeconds = parseInt(rawSeconds, 10) || 0;
        const timerElem = document.getElementById('countdown-timer');

        if (timerElem && remainingSeconds > 0) {
            function updateTimer() {
                if (remainingSeconds <= 0) {
                    timerElem.innerText = "¡Disponible!";
                    location.reload();
                    return;
                }
                const hours = Math.floor(remainingSeconds / 3600);
                const minutes = Math.floor((remainingSeconds % 3600) / 60);
                const seconds = remainingSeconds % 60;
                timerElem.innerText = `${hours}h ${minutes}m ${seconds}s`;
                remainingSeconds--;
            }
            updateTimer();
            setInterval(updateTimer, 1000);
        }
    });
</script>
{% endblock %}

<script>
    function switchTab(tab) {
        ['subir', 'cajas', 'proxima', 'cartas'].forEach(t => {
            const p = document.getElementById(`tab-${t}`);
            const b = document.getElementById(`tab-btn-${t}`);
            if (p && b) {
                if (t === tab) {
                    p.classList.remove('hidden');
                    b.className = "py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-vip-gold text-black font-black shadow transition-all";
                } else {
                    p.classList.add('hidden');
                    b.className = "py-2.5 rounded-xl text-stone-400 hover:text-white transition-all";
                }
            }
        });
    }

    // Selector y preview táctil para móviles
    function previewImageSelection(input, previewImgId, containerId, filenameId) {
        if (input.files && input.files[0]) {
            const file = input.files[0];
            const reader = new FileReader();
            reader.onload = function(e) {
                const img = document.getElementById(previewImgId);
                const container = document.getElementById(containerId);
                const nameLabel = document.getElementById(filenameId);
                if (img) img.src = e.target.result;
                if (nameLabel) nameLabel.innerText = file.name;
                if (container) container.classList.remove('hidden');
            };
            reader.readAsDataURL(file);
        }
    }

    function clearFileSelection(inputId, containerId, labelId, defaultText) {
        const input = document.getElementById(inputId);
        const container = document.getElementById(containerId);
        const label = document.getElementById(labelId);
        if (input) input.value = '';
        if (container) container.classList.add('hidden');
        if (label) label.innerText = defaultText;
    }

    function openEditCardModal(cardId, name, idolName, rarity, boxId) {
        document.getElementById('modal-card-id').value = cardId;
        document.getElementById('modal-card-name').value = name;
        document.getElementById('modal-idol-name').value = idolName;
        document.getElementById('modal-card-rarity').value = rarity;
        document.getElementById('modal-box-id').value = boxId;
        document.getElementById('edit-card-modal').classList.remove('hidden');
    }

    function closeEditCardModal() {
        document.getElementById('edit-card-modal').classList.add('hidden');
    }

    // Restaurar automáticamente la pestaña correcta si viene por parámetro URL
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
        const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
        const tab = urlParams.get('tab') || '{{ current_tab|default:"subir" }}';
        switchTab(tab);
    });
</script>
{% endblock %}

<script>
    function elegirRol(rolElegido) {
        let tgId = document.getElementById('real_tg_id').value;
        const tgApp = window.Telegram?.WebApp;
        
        // Si no venía en el formulario, tomarlo de Telegram en vivo
        if (!tgId || tgId === 'None' || tgId === 'undefined' || tgId === '123456789') {
            const user = tgApp?.initDataUnsafe?.user;
            if (user?.id) {
                tgId = String(user.id);
            } else if (typeof window.getGlobalTgId === 'function') {
                tgId = window.getGlobalTgId();
            }
            document.getElementById('real_tg_id').value = tgId;
        }
        
        document.getElementById('selected_role').value = rolElegido;
        document.getElementById('roleForm').submit();
    }
</script>

<script>
    function togglePriceField() {
        const net = document.getElementById('network-select').value;
        const cont = document.getElementById('price-container');
        if (net === 'fans') {
            cont.classList.remove('hidden');
        } else {
            cont.classList.add('hidden');
        }
    }

    function setMediaType(type) {
        document.getElementById('media-type-input').value = type;
        const btnImg = document.getElementById('btn-media-image');
        const btnVid = document.getElementById('btn-media-video');
        const boxImg = document.getElementById('image-upload-box');
        const boxVid = document.getElementById('video-upload-box');

        if (type === 'video') {
            btnVid.className = "py-2.5 rounded-xl border-2 border-purple-400 bg-purple-950/60 text-purple-200 font-bold text-xs uppercase flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(168,85,247,0.4)]";
            btnImg.className = "py-2.5 rounded-xl border border-white/20 bg-black/60 text-stone-400 font-bold text-xs uppercase flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5";
            boxVid.classList.remove('hidden');
            boxImg.classList.add('hidden');
        } else {
            btnImg.className = "py-2.5 rounded-xl border-2 border-yellow-400 bg-yellow-500/20 text-yellow-300 font-bold text-xs uppercase flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 shadow";
            btnVid.className = "py-2.5 rounded-xl border border-white/20 bg-black/60 text-stone-400 font-bold text-xs uppercase flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5";
            boxImg.classList.remove('hidden');
            boxVid.classList.add('hidden');
        }
    }

    function handleImageSelection(input) {
        const files = Array.from(input.files || []).slice(0, 5);
        const container = document.getElementById('preview-thumbnails');
        const badge = document.getElementById('carousel-count-badge');

        if (files.length === 0) {
            container.classList.add('hidden');
            container.innerHTML = '';
            badge.innerText = '📸 1 a 5 fotos';
            return;
        }

        badge.innerText = files.length > 1 ? `📸 Carrusel (${files.length} fotos)` : `📸 1 foto seleccionada`;
        container.innerHTML = '';
        container.classList.remove('hidden');
        container.classList.add('grid');

        files.forEach((file, idx) => {
            const reader = new FileReader();
            reader.onload = (e) => {
                const thumb = document.createElement('div');
                thumb.className = "relative aspect-square rounded-xl overflow-hidden border border-amber-500/40 bg-black shadow";
                thumb.innerHTML = `
                    <img src="${e.target.result}" class="w-full h-full object-cover">
                    <span class="absolute bottom-0.5 right-0.5 bg-black/80 text-[8px] font-mono font-bold text-yellow-400 px-1 rounded">
                        #${idx + 1}
                    </span>
                `;
                container.appendChild(thumb);
            };
            reader.readAsDataURL(file);
        });
    }
</script>
{% endblock %}

<script>
    function switchIdolTab(tabName) {
        ['muro', 'esencia', 'resenas'].forEach(t => {
            const panel = document.getElementById(`id-tab-${t}`);
            const btn = document.getElementById(`id-tab-btn-${t}`);
            if (panel && btn) {
                if (t === tabName) {
                    panel.classList.remove('hidden');
                    btn.className = "py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-vip-gold text-black font-black shadow transition-all";
                } else {
                    panel.classList.add('hidden');
                    btn.className = "py-2.5 rounded-xl text-stone-400 hover:text-white transition-all";
                }
            }
        });
    }

    function toggleCustomRequestModal() {
        const modal = document.getElementById('custom-request-modal');
        modal.classList.toggle('hidden');
    }

    function contactIdol(rawUsername, fallbackId) {
        let cleanUser = String(rawUsername || '').replace('@', '').trim();
        if (!cleanUser || cleanUser === 'None' || cleanUser === 'undefined' || cleanUser === 'MusaReal') {
            if (fallbackId && fallbackId !== '0') {
                window.location.href = `https://t.me/user?id=${fallbackId}`;
                return;
            }
            alert("Esta Musa no tiene un enlace de contacto activo configurado.");
            return;
        }

        const tgWebUrl = `https://t.me/${cleanUser}`;
        if (window.Telegram?.WebApp?.openTelegramLink) {
            try {
                window.Telegram.WebApp.openTelegramLink(tgWebUrl);
                return;
            } catch(e) {}
        }
        window.open(tgWebUrl, '_blank');
    }

    function toggleRoleplayModal() {
    const m = document.getElementById('roleplay-request-modal');
    if (m) m.classList.toggle('hidden');
    }
</script>
{% endblock %}

<script>
    const tgId = "{{ tg_id }}";
    const csrfToken = "{{ csrf_token }}";
    let activeFilterType = 'all';
    let activeMusaFilter = 'all';

    // 🌟 TOAST VIP ELEGANTE (SIN ALERT GRIS)
    function showVipToast(msg, icon = '✨') {
        const toast = document.getElementById('vip-toast');
        const txt = document.getElementById('vip-toast-msg');
        const ico = document.getElementById('vip-toast-icon');
        if (!toast || !txt) return;
        txt.innerText = msg;
        ico.innerText = icon;
        toast.classList.remove('opacity-0', '-translate-y-4');
        toast.classList.add('opacity-100', 'translate-y-0');
        setTimeout(() => {
            toast.classList.remove('opacity-100', 'translate-y-0');
            toast.classList.add('opacity-0', '-translate-y-4');
        }, 3200);
    }

    // 🔊 SONIDO SUTIL DE MONEDAS
    function playCoinChime() {
        try {
            const ctx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
            const now = ctx.currentTime;
            [880, 1174.66, 1760].forEach((freq, i) => {
                const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
                const gain = ctx.createGain();
                osc.type = 'sine';
                osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, now + i * 0.08);
                gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.12, now + i * 0.08);
                gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + i * 0.08 + 0.35);
                osc.connect(gain);
                gain.connect(ctx.destination);
                osc.start(now + i * 0.08);
                osc.stop(now + i * 0.08 + 0.36);
            });
        } catch(e) {}
    }

    // 🌧️ LLUVIA DE MONEDAS ANIMADA
    function spawnCoinShower() {
        for (let i = 0; i < 22; i++) {
            const coin = document.createElement('div');
            coin.innerText = '🪙';
            coin.className = 'fixed z-50 pointer-events-none text-2xl transition-all select-none';
            coin.style.left = `${Math.random() * 85 + 5}vw`;
            coin.style.top = '-40px';
            coin.style.transition = `transform ${1.2 + Math.random() * 0.8}s cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1), opacity 1.8s ease`;
            document.body.appendChild(coin);

            setTimeout(() => {
                coin.style.transform = `translateY(${window.innerHeight + 100}px) rotate(${Math.random() * 720 - 360}deg)`;
                coin.style.opacity = '0';
            }, 30);

            setTimeout(() => coin.remove(), 2200);
        }
    }

    // 📱 DETECTOR TÁCTIL NATIVO PARA DOBLE TOQUE (INSTAGRAM REAL)
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
        document.querySelectorAll('[id^="media-wrapper-"]').forEach(wrapper => {
            let lastTap = 0;
            const postId = wrapper.dataset.postId;
            
            wrapper.addEventListener('pointerup', (e) => {
                // Ignorar si el usuario está haciendo click en un botón o en el overlay
                if (e.target.closest('button') || e.target.closest('#unlock-overlay-' + postId)) return;
                
                const currentTime = new Date().getTime();
                const tapLength = currentTime - lastTap;
                
                if (tapLength < 320 && tapLength > 0) {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    triggerHeartAnimation(postId);
                    submitReaction(postId, 'like');
                    lastTap = 0;
                } else {
                    lastTap = currentTime;
                }
            });
        });
    });

    function triggerHeartAnimation(postId) {
        const burst = document.getElementById(`heart-burst-${postId}`);
        if (!burst) return;
        burst.classList.remove('opacity-0', 'scale-50');
        burst.classList.add('opacity-100', 'scale-125');
        try { window.Telegram?.WebApp?.HapticFeedback?.impactOccurred('medium'); } catch(e) {}
        setTimeout(() => {
            burst.classList.remove('opacity-100', 'scale-125');
            burst.classList.add('opacity-0', 'scale-50');
        }, 550);
    }

    // ❤️ 1. LIKE RÁPIDO INSTANTÁNEO (1 TOQUE)
    function toggleInstantLike(postId, e) {
        if (e) e.stopPropagation();
        submitReaction(postId, 'like');
    }

    // 🎭 2. ABRIR DOCK DE REACCIONES DE LA CORTE
    function openReactionDock(postId, e) {
        if (e) e.stopPropagation();
        dismissAllReactionDocks();
        const dock = document.getElementById(`reactions-dock-${postId}`);
        if (dock) dock.classList.remove('hidden');
    }

    function dismissAllReactionDocks(e) {
        document.querySelectorAll('[id^="reactions-dock-"]').forEach(d => d.classList.add('hidden'));
    }

    function submitCourtReaction(postId, reactionCode, e) {
        if (e) e.stopPropagation();
        dismissAllReactionDocks();
        submitReaction(postId, reactionCode);
    }

    async function submitReaction(postId, reactionCode) {
        try { window.Telegram?.WebApp?.HapticFeedback?.impactOccurred('light'); } catch(e) {}
        const fd = new FormData();
        fd.append('tg_id', tgId);
        fd.append('reaction', reactionCode);
        fd.append('csrfmiddlewaretoken', csrfToken);

        try {
            const resp = await fetch(`/idols/feed/react/${postId}/`, {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest' },
                body: fd
            });
            const data = await resp.json();
            if (data.success) {
                const countEl = document.getElementById(`like-count-${postId}`);
                const iconEl = document.getElementById(`react-icon-${postId}`);
                if (countEl) countEl.innerText = data.total_likes;

                const emojis = {'like': '❤️', 'fire': '🔥', 'crown': '👑', 'toast': '🥂', 'drool': '🤤'};
                const active = data.active_reaction || data.current_reaction;
                if (iconEl) {
                    iconEl.innerText = (data.active && active) ? (emojis[active] || '❤️') : '🤍';
                }
            }
        } catch(e) {}
    }

    // 📸 3. CARRUSEL: ACTUALIZADOR DE PÁGINA Y PUNTOS CON SWIPE
    function handleCarouselScroll(postId) {
        const carousel = document.getElementById(`carousel-${postId}`);
        const dotsBox = document.getElementById(`dots-${postId}`);
        const badge = document.getElementById(`badge-page-${postId}`);
        if (!carousel) return;

        const width = carousel.offsetWidth || 1;
        const activeIdx = Math.round(carousel.scrollLeft / width);
        const totalSlides = carousel.querySelectorAll('.snap-center').length;

        if (badge) {
            badge.innerText = `${activeIdx + 1}/${totalSlides}`;
        }

        if (dotsBox) {
            const dots = dotsBox.querySelectorAll('.carousel-dot');
            dots.forEach((dot, idx) => {
                if (idx === activeIdx) {
                    dot.className = "carousel-dot w-4 h-2 rounded-full border border-black/80 bg-yellow-400 transition-all duration-300";
                } else {
                    dot.className = "carousel-dot w-2 h-2 rounded-full border border-black/80 bg-white/60 transition-all duration-300";
                }
            });
        }
    }

    // ⚡ 4. DESBLOQUEO AJAX DE FOTO/VIDEO SIN RECARGA
    async function unlockPostAjax(postId, price) {
        const btn = document.getElementById(`btn-unlock-${postId}`);
        if (btn) {
            btn.disabled = true;
            btn.innerHTML = `<span>Desbloqueando...</span> 🪙`;
        }

        const fd = new FormData();
        fd.append('tg_id', tgId);
        fd.append('ajax', '1');
        fd.append('csrfmiddlewaretoken', csrfToken);

        try {
            const resp = await fetch(`/idols/feed/unlock/${postId}/`, {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest' },
                body: fd
            });
            const data = await resp.json();

            if (data.success) {
                try { window.Telegram?.WebApp?.HapticFeedback?.notificationOccurred('success'); } catch(e) {}
                playCoinChime();
                showVipToast(data.message || '¡Publicación desbloqueada con éxito!', '👑');

                const balEl = document.getElementById('feed-user-balance');
                if (balEl && data.new_balance !== undefined) {
                    balEl.innerText = data.new_balance;
                }

                // Ocultar Overlay
                const overlay = document.getElementById(`unlock-overlay-${postId}`);
                if (overlay) overlay.remove();

                // Revelar Imagen o Montar Carrusel
                const mediaWrapper = document.getElementById(`media-wrapper-${postId}`);
                if (mediaWrapper && data.media_urls && data.media_urls.length > 0) {
                    if (data.is_video && data.video_url) {
                        mediaWrapper.innerHTML = `
                            <video src="${data.video_url}" controls playsinline autoplay loop class="w-full max-h-[580px] object-contain bg-black"></video>
                            <span class="absolute top-3 right-3 bg-emerald-950/95 border border-emerald-400 text-emerald-200 text-[9px] font-mono font-black uppercase px-3 py-1 rounded-full shadow-xl z-20">✓ Desbloqueada</span>
                        `;
                    } else {
                        let slidesHtml = '';
                        let dotsHtml = '';
                        data.media_urls.forEach((url, i) => {
                            slidesHtml += `
                                <div class="w-full flex-shrink-0 snap-center flex items-center justify-center">
                                    <img src="${url}" class="w-full max-h-[580px] object-contain cursor-zoom-in active:opacity-95" onclick="openImageLightbox('${url}', '')">
                                </div>
                            `;
                            dotsHtml += `<span class="carousel-dot ${i === 0 ? 'bg-yellow-400 w-4' : 'bg-white/60 w-2'} h-2 rounded-full border border-black/80 transition-all duration-300"></span>`;
                        });

                        const multiDots = data.media_urls.length > 1 ? `
                            <div class="absolute bottom-3 inset-x-0 flex justify-center gap-1.5 z-20 pointer-events-none" id="dots-${postId}">${dotsHtml}</div>
                            <span id="badge-page-${postId}" class="absolute top-3 left-3 bg-black/85 border border-vip-gold/50 text-yellow-300 text-[10px] font-mono font-black px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full z-20">1/${data.media_urls.length}</span>
                        ` : '';

                        mediaWrapper.innerHTML = `
                            <div class="carousel-track w-full max-h-[580px] flex overflow-x-auto snap-x snap-mandatory scroll-smooth no-scrollbar relative" id="carousel-${postId}" onscroll="handleCarouselScroll(${postId})">
                                ${slidesHtml}
                            </div>
                            ${multiDots}
                            <span class="absolute top-3 right-3 bg-emerald-950/95 border border-emerald-400 text-emerald-200 text-[9px] font-mono font-black uppercase px-3 py-1 rounded-full shadow-xl z-20">✓ Desbloqueada</span>
                        `;
                    }
                }

                const article = document.getElementById(`post-${postId}`);
                if (article) article.dataset.unlocked = 'true';

            } else {
                showVipToast(data.error || 'No se pudo desbloquear.', '⚠️');
                if (btn) {
                    btn.disabled = false;
                    btn.innerHTML = `<span>Desbloquear</span> <span class="font-mono text-sm font-black">🪙 ${price}</span>`;
                }
            }
        } catch(e) {
            showVipToast('Error de conexión.', '❌');
            if (btn) {
                btn.disabled = false;
                btn.innerHTML = `<span>Desbloquear</span> <span class="font-mono text-sm font-black">🪙 ${price}</span>`;
            }
        }
    }

    // 💬 5. COMENTARIOS AJAX CON IDENTIDAD COMPLETA
    function toggleComments(postId) {

    function setReplyTarget(postId, commentId, authorName) {

    function cancelReply(postId) {

    async function submitCommentAjax(postId, e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        const input = document.getElementById(`comment-input-${postId}`);
        const text = input.value.trim();
        const parentId = document.getElementById(`parent-input-${postId}`).value;
        const btn = document.getElementById(`btn-submit-comment-${postId}`);
        if (!text) return;

        btn.disabled = true;
        const fd = new FormData();
        fd.append('tg_id', tgId);
        fd.append('text', text);
        if (parentId) fd.append('parent_id', parentId);
        fd.append('ajax', '1');
        fd.append('csrfmiddlewaretoken', csrfToken);

        try {
            const resp = await fetch(`/idols/feed/comment/${postId}/`, {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest' },
                body: fd
            });
            const data = await resp.json();
            if (data.success) {
                input.value = '';
                cancelReply(postId);
                btn.disabled = false;
                try { window.Telegram?.WebApp?.HapticFeedback?.notificationOccurred('success'); } catch(e) {}

                const cCount = document.getElementById(`comment-count-${postId}`);
                if (cCount) cCount.innerText = data.total_comments;

                const emptyMsg = document.getElementById(`empty-comment-msg-${postId}`);
                if (emptyMsg) emptyMsg.remove();

                const c = data.comment;
                const frameClass = c.avatar_frame === 'flame' ? 'bg-rose-950/80 border-2 border-rose-500 shadow-[0_0_10px_rgba(244,63,94,0.6)]' :
                                  (c.avatar_frame === 'diamond' ? 'bg-cyan-950/80 border-2 border-cyan-400 shadow-[0_0_10px_rgba(34,211,238,0.6)]' :
                                  (c.avatar_frame === 'neon' ? 'bg-purple-950/80 border-2 border-purple-400 shadow-[0_0_10px_rgba(168,85,247,0.6)]' :
                                  'bg-yellow-950/80 border-2 border-yellow-400 shadow-[0_0_10px_rgba(234,179,8,0.6)]'));

                if (c.parent_id) {
                    const repBox = document.getElementById(`replies-${c.parent_id}`);
                    if (repBox) {
                        repBox.classList.remove('hidden');
                        const rDiv = document.createElement('div');
                        rDiv.className = "bg-purple-950/20 border border-purple-500/20 p-2 rounded-xl flex flex-col gap-0.5 animate-fade-in";
                        rDiv.innerHTML = `
                            <div class="flex justify-between items-center text-[9px]">
                                <span class="font-bold flex items-center gap-1 text-purple-200">
                                    ↳ ${c.author_name}
                                    <span class="text-[7.5px] bg-black/60 text-purple-300 px-1 rounded font-mono">L${c.level || 1}</span>
                                </span>
                                <span class="text-stone-500 font-mono">ahora</span>
                            </div>
                            <p class="text-stone-300 text-[11px] leading-relaxed">${c.text}</p>
                        `;
                        repBox.appendChild(rDiv);
                    }
                } else {
                    const list = document.getElementById(`comments-list-${postId}`);
                    const cDiv = document.createElement('div');
                    cDiv.className = "bg-black/75 border border-white/10 p-2.5 rounded-2xl text-xs flex flex-col gap-1.5 shadow animate-fade-in";
                    cDiv.innerHTML = `
                        <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
                            <div class="flex items-center gap-2 min-w-0">
                                <div class="w-7 h-7 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center text-xs flex-shrink-0 shadow ${frameClass}">
                                    <span>🥂</span>
                                </div>
                                <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap min-w-0">
                                    <span class="font-bold text-[11px] text-white truncate">${c.author_name}</span>
                                    <span class="text-[8px] bg-purple-950/90 border border-purple-500/40 text-purple-200 px-1 rounded font-mono font-black">L${c.level || 1}</span>
                                    ${c.title ? `<span class="text-[8px] text-yellow-400 font-serif italic truncate">${c.title}</span>` : ''}
                                    ${c.is_vip_author ? '<span class="bg-gradient-to-r from-yellow-500 to-amber-500 text-black text-[7.5px] font-mono font-black uppercase px-1.5 rounded-full">👑 VIP</span>' : ''}
                                </div>
                            </div>
                            <span class="text-stone-500 font-mono text-[9px]">ahora</span>
                        </div>
                        <p class="text-stone-200 text-xs leading-relaxed pl-9">${c.text}</p>
                    `;
                    list.appendChild(cDiv);
                    cDiv.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest' });
                }
            }
        } catch(e) {
            btn.disabled = false;
        }
    }

    async function submitTipAjax(e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        const postId = document.getElementById('tip-post-id').value;
        const amount = document.getElementById('tip-amount-input').value;
        const btn = document.getElementById('btn-submit-tip');
        if (!amount || amount <= 0) return;

        btn.disabled = true;
        const fd = new FormData();
        fd.append('tg_id', tgId);
        fd.append('tip_amount', amount);
        fd.append('ajax', '1');

        try {
            const resp = await fetch(`/idols/feed/tip/${postId}/`, {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest' },
                body: fd
            });
            const data = await resp.json();
            if (data.success) {
                closeTipModal();
                btn.disabled = false;
                playCoinChime();
                spawnCoinShower();
                try { window.Telegram?.WebApp?.HapticFeedback?.notificationOccurred('success'); } catch(e) {}

                const balEl = document.getElementById('feed-user-balance');
                if (balEl && data.new_balance !== undefined) balEl.innerText = data.new_balance;
                showVipToast(data.message || `¡Has brindado ${amount}🪙 con la Musa!`, '🥂');
            } else {
                showVipToast(data.error || 'No se pudo enviar el brindis.', '⚠️');
                btn.disabled = false;
            }
        } catch(e) {
            btn.disabled = false;
            showVipToast('Error de conexión.', '❌');
        }
    }

    // 🔍 7. SISTEMA DE FILTROS COMBINADOS (TIPO + MUSA)
    function setFeedFilter(filterType) {
        activeFilterType = filterType;
        ['all', 'vip', 'my_unlocked', 'popular'].forEach(f => {
            const btn = document.getElementById(`flt-${f === 'my_unlocked' ? 'my' : (f === 'popular' ? 'pop' : f)}`);
            if (btn) {
                if (f === filterType) {
                    btn.className = "filter-pill py-2 rounded-xl font-black transition-all bg-vip-gold text-black shadow";
                } else {
                    btn.className = "filter-pill py-2 rounded-xl text-stone-400 hover:text-white transition-all";
                }
            }
        });
        applyFeedFilters();
    }

    function setMusaFilter(idolId) {
        activeMusaFilter = idolId;
        applyFeedFilters();
    }

    function applyFeedFilters() {
        const items = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.feed-item'));
        const container = document.getElementById('feed-container');

        // Ordenamiento por Top si aplica
        if (activeFilterType === 'popular') {
            items.sort((a, b) => parseInt(b.dataset.likes || 0) - parseInt(a.dataset.likes || 0));
            items.forEach(el => container.appendChild(el));
        }

        items.forEach(el => {
            let matchType = false;
            if (activeFilterType === 'all' || activeFilterType === 'popular') {
                matchType = true;
            } else if (activeFilterType === 'vip') {
                matchType = (el.dataset.network === 'fans');
            } else if (activeFilterType === 'my_unlocked') {
                matchType = (el.dataset.unlocked === 'true' && el.dataset.network === 'fans');
            }

            const matchMusa = (activeMusaFilter === 'all' || el.dataset.idolId === activeMusaFilter);

            el.style.display = (matchType && matchMusa) ? 'block' : 'none';
        });
    }

    // LIGHTBOX
    function openImageLightbox(src, caption) {
        const lb = document.getElementById('image-lightbox');
        const img = document.getElementById('lightbox-img');
        const cap = document.getElementById('lightbox-caption');
        img.src = src;
        cap.innerText = caption;
        lb.classList.remove('hidden');
    }

    function closeImageLightbox() {
        document.getElementById('image-lightbox').classList.add('hidden');
    }


    // 🗑️ ELIMINAR PUBLICACIÓN CON CONFIRMACIÓN Y ANIMACIÓN SUAVE
    async function confirmDeletePost(postId) {
        if (!confirm('¿Estás segura/o de que deseas eliminar esta publicación del Muro VIP? Esta acción no se puede deshacer.')) {
            return;
        }

        try {
            const formData = new FormData();
            formData.append('csrfmiddlewaretoken', csrfToken);
            formData.append('tg_id', tgId);
            formData.append('ajax', '1');

            const resp = await fetch(`/idols/feed/delete/${postId}/?tg_id=${tgId}`, {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: {
                    'X-CSRFToken': csrfToken,
                    'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest'
                },
                body: formData
            });

            const data = await resp.json().catch(() => null);

            if (resp.ok && (!data || data.success !== false)) {
                showVipToast(data?.message || '🗑️ Publicación eliminada del Muro.', '🗑️');
                const postEl = document.getElementById(`post-${postId}`);
                if (postEl) {
                    postEl.style.transition = 'all 0.35s ease-out';
                    postEl.style.opacity = '0';
                    postEl.style.transform = 'scale(0.92)';
                    setTimeout(() => postEl.remove(), 350);
                }
            } else {
                alert(data?.error || 'No se pudo eliminar la publicación.');
            }
        } catch (err) {
            // Fallback por envío estándar de formulario POST si fetch falla
            const form = document.createElement('form');
            form.method = 'POST';
            form.action = `/idols/feed/delete/${postId}/?tg_id=${tgId}`;
            const tokenInput = document.createElement('input');
            tokenInput.type = 'hidden';
            tokenInput.name = 'csrfmiddlewaretoken';
            tokenInput.value = csrfToken;
            form.appendChild(tokenInput);
            document.body.appendChild(form);
            form.submit();
        }
    }
</script>
{% endblock %}

<script>
    function switchStudioTab(tab) {
        ['identidad', 'estilo', 'fotos'].forEach(t => {
            const panel = document.getElementById(`s-tab-${t}`);
            const btn = document.getElementById(`s-tab-btn-${t}`);
            if (panel && btn) {
                if (t === tab) {
                    panel.classList.remove('hidden');
                    btn.className = "py-2 rounded-xl bg-vip-gold text-black font-black shadow transition-all";
                } else {
                    panel.classList.add('hidden');
                    btn.className = "py-2 rounded-xl text-stone-400 hover:text-white transition-all";
                }
            }
        });
    }

    function updatePreviewText(elementId, value, defaultText) {
        const el = document.getElementById(elementId);
        if (el) el.innerText = value.trim() ? value : defaultText;
    }

    function changeAuraPreview(aura, hexColor) {
        document.getElementById('previewCardBorder').style.borderColor = hexColor;
        document.getElementById('previewAvatarRing').style.borderColor = hexColor;
    }

    function changeStatusPreview(status) {
        const badge = document.getElementById('previewStatusBadge');
        const dot = document.getElementById('previewStatusDot');
        const text = document.getElementById('previewStatusText');

        if (status === 'online') {
            badge.className = "inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[8px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border shadow bg-emerald-950 text-emerald-300 border-emerald-400";
            dot.className = "w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 animate-ping";
            text.innerText = "Chateando";
        } else if (status === 'antojos') {
            badge.className = "inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[8px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border shadow bg-rose-950 text-rose-300 border-rose-400";
            dot.className = "w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-rose-400 animate-pulse";
            text.innerText = "Antojos";
        } else {
            badge.className = "inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[8px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border shadow bg-neutral-900 text-stone-400 border-stone-600";
            dot.className = "w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-stone-500";
            text.innerText = "Descanso";
        }
    }

    function previewPhotoFile(input) {
        if (input.files && input.files[0]) {
            const file = input.files[0];
            const reader = new FileReader();
            reader.onload = e => {
                document.getElementById('previewPhotoImg').src = e.target.result;
                document.getElementById('photo-file-label').innerText = `✓ Foto elegida: ${file.name}`;
            };
            reader.readAsDataURL(file);
        }
    }

    function previewPhotoUrl(url) {
        if (url && url.startsWith('http')) {
            document.getElementById('previewPhotoImg').src = url;
        }
    }

    function previewBannerFile(input) {
        if (input.files && input.files[0]) {
            const file = input.files[0];
            const reader = new FileReader();
            reader.onload = e => {
                document.getElementById('previewBannerImg').src = e.target.result;
                document.getElementById('banner-file-label').innerText = `✓ Banner elegido: ${file.name}`;
            };
            reader.readAsDataURL(file);
        }
    }

    function previewBannerUrl(url) {
        if (url && url.startsWith('http')) {
            document.getElementById('previewBannerImg').src = url;
        }
    }

    function validateIdolForm() {
        const hasExistingPhoto = {% if idol and idol.safe_photo_url %}true{% else %}false{% endif %};
        const fileSelected = document.getElementById('idol-photo-file').files.length > 0;
        const urlTyped = document.getElementById('photo_url_input').value.trim().length > 0;

        if (!hasExistingPhoto && !fileSelected && !urlTyped) {
            alert("⚠️ Debes elegir una foto de perfil (desde tu dispositivo o pegando un enlace web).");
            switchStudioTab('fotos');
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }
</script>
{% endblock %}

<script>
    let currentQuickFilter = 'all';

    function setQuickFilter(type) {
        currentQuickFilter = type;
        document.querySelectorAll('.quick-filter-btn').forEach(btn => {
            btn.className = "py-2 rounded-xl text-stone-400 hover:text-white transition-all quick-filter-btn";
        });
        const active = document.getElementById(`g-filter-${type}`);
        if (active) active.className = "py-2 rounded-xl bg-vip-gold text-black font-black shadow transition-all quick-filter-btn";
        filterGalleryLive();
    }

    function applySortLive(sortMode) {
        const grid = document.getElementById('gallery-grid');
        const cards = Array.from(grid.querySelectorAll('.idol-card'));

        cards.sort((a, b) => {
            // 🌟 MUSA DESTACADA SIEMPRE PRIMERA
            const featA = a.getAttribute('data-featured') === '1' ? 1 : 0;
            const featB = b.getAttribute('data-featured') === '1' ? 1 : 0;
            if (featA !== featB) return featB - featA;

            if (sortMode === 'owner') {
                const ownerA = a.getAttribute('data-owner') || '';
                const ownerB = b.getAttribute('data-owner') || '';
                return ownerA.localeCompare(ownerB);
            } else if (sortMode === 'services') {
                const sA = parseInt(a.getAttribute('data-services') || '0', 10);
                const sB = parseInt(b.getAttribute('data-services') || '0', 10);
                return sB - sA;
            } else if (sortMode === 'recent') {
                const dA = parseInt(a.getAttribute('data-created') || '0', 10);
                const dB = parseInt(b.getAttribute('data-created') || '0', 10);
                return dB - dA;
            } else {
                const rA = parseFloat(a.getAttribute('data-rating') || '0');
                const rB = parseFloat(b.getAttribute('data-rating') || '0');
                return rB - rA;
            }
        });

        cards.forEach(card => grid.appendChild(card));
        filterGalleryLive();
    }

    function filterGalleryLive() {
        const query = (document.getElementById('gallerySearchInput')?.value || '').toLowerCase().trim();
        const selectedOwner = (document.getElementById('galleryOwnerFilter')?.value || '').toLowerCase().trim();
        const cards = document.querySelectorAll('.idol-card');

        let visibleCount = 0;

        cards.forEach(card => {
            const name = card.getAttribute('data-name') || '';
            const owner = card.getAttribute('data-owner') || '';
            const status = card.getAttribute('data-status') || '';
            const isTop = card.getAttribute('data-top') === '1';
            const isTrending = card.getAttribute('data-trending') === '1';

            const matchesText = name.includes(query) || owner.includes(query);
            const matchesOwner = !selectedOwner || owner === selectedOwner || owner.includes(selectedOwner);

            let matchesQuick = true;
            if (currentQuickFilter === 'online') matchesQuick = (status === 'online' || status === 'antojos');
            else if (currentQuickFilter === 'top') matchesQuick = isTop;
            else if (currentQuickFilter === 'trending') matchesQuick = isTrending;

            if (matchesText && matchesOwner && matchesQuick) {
                card.style.display = 'flex';
                visibleCount++;
            } else {
                card.style.display = 'none';
            }
        });

        const badge = document.getElementById('idols-count-badge');
        if (badge) badge.innerText = visibleCount;
    }
</script>
{% endblock %}

<script>
function previewAntojoMedia(event, reqId) {
    const file = event.target.files[0];
    if (file) {
        const maxBytes = 30 * 1024 * 1024; // 30 MB
        if (file.size > maxBytes) {
            alert("⚠️ El archivo seleccionado supera el límite de 30 MB.\nPor favor selecciona un archivo más ligero o un clip más corto.");
            event.target.value = '';
            return;
        }
        const previewBox = document.getElementById('preview-box-' + reqId);
        const previewImg = document.getElementById('preview-img-' + reqId);
        const previewVid = document.getElementById('preview-vid-' + reqId);
        const previewStatus = document.getElementById('preview-status-' + reqId);
        const isVideo = file.type.startsWith('video/') || /\.(mp4|mov|webm|m4v|avi)$/i.test(file.name);
        const sizeMb = (file.size / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1);
        const fileUrl = URL.createObjectURL(file);

        if (previewBox) previewBox.classList.remove('hidden');

        if (isVideo) {
            if (previewImg) previewImg.classList.add('hidden');
            if (previewVid) {
                previewVid.src = fileUrl;
                previewVid.classList.remove('hidden');
            }
            if (previewStatus) {
                previewStatus.innerHTML = `🎬 Video listo: <b>${file.name}</b> (${sizeMb} MB)`;
                previewStatus.className = "text-[8.5px] text-emerald-400 mt-1 font-bold";
            }
        } else {
            if (previewVid) {
                previewVid.classList.add('hidden');
                previewVid.pause();
            }
            if (previewImg) {
                previewImg.src = fileUrl;
                previewImg.classList.remove('hidden');
            }
            if (previewStatus) {
                previewStatus.innerHTML = `📸 Foto lista: <b>${file.name}</b> (${sizeMb} MB)`;
                previewStatus.className = "text-[8.5px] text-emerald-400 mt-1 font-bold";
            }
        }
    }
}

function showUploadSpinner(reqId) {
    const btn = document.getElementById('btn-submit-' + reqId);
    if (btn) {
        btn.innerHTML = `<span class="animate-spin text-sm">⏳</span> <span>Subiendo Archivo y Acreditando Oro...</span>`;
        btn.classList.add('opacity-75', 'pointer-events-none');
    }
}
</script>

{% endblock %}
