<script>
    let currentCardData = null;
    window.pinnedCardIds = new Set({{ pinned_card_ids|safe|default:"[]" }});
    let currentSortCriteria = 'rarity';

    function toggleCardFlip() {
        const mesh = document.getElementById('flip-card-mesh');
        if (mesh) {
            mesh.classList.toggle('is-flipped');
            try { window.Telegram?.WebApp?.HapticFeedback?.impactOccurred('light'); } catch(e) {}
        }
    }

    function switchAlbumView(viewName) {
        ['collections', 'duplicates', 'all'].forEach(v => {
            const panel = document.getElementById(`view-${v}`);
            const btn = document.getElementById(`view-btn-${v}`);
            if (panel && btn) {
                if (v === viewName) {
                    panel.classList.remove('hidden');
                    btn.className = "py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-vip-gold text-black font-black shadow transition-all album-tab-btn";
                } else {
                    panel.classList.add('hidden');
                    btn.className = "py-2.5 rounded-xl text-stone-400 hover:text-white transition-all album-tab-btn";
                }
            }
        });
        try { window.Telegram?.WebApp?.HapticFeedback?.selectionChanged(); } catch(e) {}
    }

    function sortAlbum(criteria) {
        currentSortCriteria = criteria;
        try { window.Telegram?.WebApp?.HapticFeedback?.selectionChanged(); } catch(e) {}
        
        document.querySelectorAll('.album-sort-btn').forEach(b => {
            b.className = "album-sort-btn px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-stone-400 hover:text-white transition-all font-bold";
        });
        const activeBtn = document.getElementById(`sort-btn-${criteria}`);
        if (activeBtn) {
            activeBtn.className = "album-sort-btn px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-vip-gold text-black font-black shadow transition-all";
        }

        document.querySelectorAll('.album-card-grid').forEach(grid => {
            const items = Array.from(grid.children).filter(el => el.classList.contains('album-card-item'));
            items.sort((a, b) => {
                if (criteria === 'rarity') {
                    const rA = parseInt(a.getAttribute('data-rarity-weight') || '99');
                    const rB = parseInt(b.getAttribute('data-rarity-weight') || '99');
                    if (rA !== rB) return rA - rB;
                    const nA = (a.getAttribute('data-name') || '').toLowerCase();
                    const nB = (b.getAttribute('data-name') || '').toLowerCase();
                    return nA.localeCompare(nB);
                } else if (criteria === 'name') {
                    const nA = (a.getAttribute('data-name') || '').toLowerCase();
                    const nB = (b.getAttribute('data-name') || '').toLowerCase();
                    return nA.localeCompare(nB);
                } else if (criteria === 'recent') {
                    const dA = a.getAttribute('data-date') || '';
                    const dB = b.getAttribute('data-date') || '';
                    return dB.localeCompare(dA);
                }
                return 0;
            });
            items.forEach(el => grid.appendChild(el));
        });
    }

    function filterFlatAlbum(rarity) {
        const cards = document.querySelectorAll('.flat-card-item');
        const btns = document.querySelectorAll('.flat-filter-btn');
        btns.forEach(b => { b.className = "py-1.5 rounded-xl text-stone-400 hover:text-white flat-filter-btn"; });
        const active = document.getElementById(`f-${rarity}`);
        if (active) active.className = "py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-vip-gold text-black font-bold flat-filter-btn";

        cards.forEach(c => {
            c.style.display = (rarity === 'all' || c.getAttribute('data-rarity') === rarity) ? 'flex' : 'none';
        });
    }

    function filterAlbumLive() {
        const query = (document.getElementById('albumSearchInput')?.value || '').toLowerCase().trim();
        const cards = document.querySelectorAll('.album-card-item');
        cards.forEach(c => {
            const searchData = c.getAttribute('data-search') || '';
            c.style.display = searchData.includes(query) ? 'flex' : 'none';
        });
    }

    function openCardActionModal(cardId, name, idolName, rarityDisplay, colorHex, imgUrl, isForSale, salePrice, copiesCount) {
        currentCardData = {
            id: String(cardId),
            name: name,
            title: name,
            idol: idolName,
            rarity: rarityDisplay,
            img: imgUrl
        };

        document.getElementById('modal-card-title').innerText = name;
        document.getElementById('modal-card-idol').innerText = `Idol: ${idolName}`;
        document.getElementById('flip-back-title').innerText = name;
        document.getElementById('flip-back-idol').innerText = idolName;
        document.getElementById('modal-card-rarity').innerText = rarityDisplay;
        document.getElementById('modal-card-rarity').style.borderColor = colorHex;
        document.getElementById('modal-card-rarity').style.color = colorHex;
        document.getElementById('modal-card-img').src = imgUrl || '';
        document.getElementById('modal-card-box').style.borderColor = colorHex;
        document.getElementById('modal-card-box').style.boxShadow = `0 0 25px ${colorHex}55`;

        const mesh = document.getElementById('flip-card-mesh');
        if (mesh) mesh.classList.remove('is-flipped');

        const sellForm = document.getElementById('sell-form');
        const tradeForm = document.getElementById('trade-form');
        const cancelForm = document.getElementById('cancel-sale-form');
        sellForm.action = `/idols/photocards/sell/${cardId}/`;
        tradeForm.action = `/idols/photocards/trade/${cardId}/`;
        cancelForm.action = `/idols/photocards/cancel_sale/${cardId}/`;

        const saleBox = document.getElementById('modal-is-for-sale-box');
        const actionsBox = document.getElementById('modal-actions-box');
        if (isForSale) {
            saleBox.classList.remove('hidden');
            actionsBox.classList.add('hidden');
            document.getElementById('modal-sale-price-label').innerText = salePrice;
        } else {
            saleBox.classList.add('hidden');
            actionsBox.classList.remove('hidden');
        }

        const btnPin = document.getElementById('btn-pin-card');
        if (btnPin) {
            const isPinned = window.pinnedCardIds && window.pinnedCardIds.has(String(cardId));
            if (isPinned) {
                btnPin.innerHTML = `<span>✅</span> <span>Fijada en Perfil (Toca para Desanclar)</span>`;
                btnPin.className = "w-full py-2.5 bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-600 via-teal-500 to-emerald-400 hover:brightness-110 text-white font-black text-xs uppercase rounded-xl shadow-lg active:scale-95 transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 ring-2 ring-emerald-300";
            } else {
                btnPin.innerHTML = `<span>📌</span> <span>Fijar en mi Perfil (Expositor)</span>`;
                btnPin.className = "w-full py-2.5 bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-500 via-yellow-400 to-amber-300 hover:brightness-110 text-black font-black text-xs uppercase rounded-xl shadow-lg active:scale-95 transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5";
            }
        }

        document.getElementById('modal-copies-num').innerText = copiesCount;
        document.getElementById('card-action-modal').classList.remove('hidden');
        try { window.Telegram?.WebApp?.HapticFeedback?.impactOccurred('medium'); } catch(e) {}
    }

    function closeCardActionModal() {
        document.getElementById('card-action-modal').classList.add('hidden');
    }

    function openLockedCardModal(name, idolName, rarityDisplay, colorHex, boxName, imgUrl) {
        document.getElementById('locked-modal-title').innerText = name;
        document.getElementById('locked-modal-idol').innerText = idolName ? ('Idol: ' + idolName) : '';
        document.getElementById('locked-modal-box').innerText = boxName;
        const rEl = document.getElementById('locked-modal-rarity');
        rEl.innerText = rarityDisplay;
        rEl.style.borderColor = colorHex;
        rEl.style.color = colorHex;
        document.getElementById('locked-modal-img').src = imgUrl || '';
        document.getElementById('locked-card-modal').classList.remove('hidden');
        try { window.Telegram?.WebApp?.HapticFeedback?.impactOccurred('light'); } catch(e) {}
    }

    function closeLockedCardModal() {
        document.getElementById('locked-card-modal').classList.add('hidden');
    }

    // Función para anclar carta en el Expositor de Honor del Perfil
    async function pinCurrentCardToProfile() {
        if (!currentCardData) {
            alert('⚠️ Selecciona una photocard primero.');
            return;
        }
        const btn = document.getElementById('btn-pin-card');
        const prevHtml = btn ? btn.innerHTML : '';
        if (btn) btn.innerHTML = `<span>⏳</span> <span>Actualizando Expositor...</span>`;
        
        try {
            const formData = new FormData();
            formData.append('type', 'photocard');
            formData.append('id', currentCardData.id || '0');
            formData.append('name', currentCardData.name || currentCardData.title || 'Photocard');
            formData.append('image', currentCardData.img || '');
            formData.append('rarity', currentCardData.rarity || '');
            formData.append('series', currentCardData.idol || 'Colección Real');

            let tgId = '{{ tg_id }}';
            try {
                if (window.Telegram && window.Telegram.WebApp && window.Telegram.WebApp.initDataUnsafe && window.Telegram.WebApp.initDataUnsafe.user) {
                    tgId = window.Telegram.WebApp.initDataUnsafe.user.id || tgId;
                }
            } catch(e) {}
            if (tgId) formData.append('tg_id', tgId);

            const csrfToken = document.querySelector('[name=csrfmiddlewaretoken]')?.value 
                || (document.cookie.match(/csrftoken=([^;]+)/) || [])[1] 
                || '';
            formData.append('csrfmiddlewaretoken', csrfToken);

            const resp = await fetch('/profile/pin-item/', {
                method: 'POST',
                body: formData,
                headers: { 
                    'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest',
                    'X-CSRFToken': csrfToken
                }
            });

            const data = await resp.json();
            if (data.success) {
                try { window.Telegram?.WebApp?.HapticFeedback?.notificationOccurred('success'); } catch(e) {}
                if (data.is_pinned) {
                    if (window.pinnedCardIds) window.pinnedCardIds.add(String(currentCardData.id));
                    if (btn) {
                        btn.innerHTML = `<span>✅</span> <span>Fijada en Perfil (Toca para Desanclar)</span>`;
                        btn.className = "w-full py-2.5 bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-600 via-teal-500 to-emerald-400 hover:brightness-110 text-white font-black text-xs uppercase rounded-xl shadow-lg active:scale-95 transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 ring-2 ring-emerald-300";
                    }
                } else {
                    if (window.pinnedCardIds) window.pinnedCardIds.delete(String(currentCardData.id));
                    if (btn) {
                        btn.innerHTML = `<span>📌</span> <span>Fijar en mi Perfil (Expositor)</span>`;
                        btn.className = "w-full py-2.5 bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-500 via-yellow-400 to-amber-300 hover:brightness-110 text-black font-black text-xs uppercase rounded-xl shadow-lg active:scale-95 transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5";
                    }
                }
                alert(data.message);
            } else {
                alert(data.error || 'No se pudo actualizar el expositor.');
                if (btn) btn.innerHTML = prevHtml;
            }
        } catch (e) {
            console.error(e);
            alert('Error al conectar con la corte real.');
            if (btn) btn.innerHTML = prevHtml;
        }
    }
</script>
{% endblock %}

<script>
    function switchMarketTab(tab) {
        const cardsTab = document.getElementById('market-cards-tab');
        const tradesTab = document.getElementById('market-trades-tab');
        const btnCards = document.getElementById('tab-btn-cards');
        const btnTrades = document.getElementById('tab-btn-trades');

        if (tab === 'cards') {
            cardsTab.classList.remove('hidden');
            tradesTab.classList.add('hidden');
            btnCards.className = "py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-vip-gold text-black font-black shadow transition-all";
            btnTrades.className = "py-2.5 rounded-xl text-stone-400 hover:text-white transition-all";
        } else {
            cardsTab.classList.add('hidden');
            tradesTab.classList.remove('hidden');
            btnTrades.className = "py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-vip-gold text-black font-black shadow transition-all";
            btnCards.className = "py-2.5 rounded-xl text-stone-400 hover:text-white transition-all";
        }
    }

    let selectedMarketRarity = 'all';

    function setRarityFilter(rarity) {
        selectedMarketRarity = rarity;
        document.querySelectorAll('.m-rarity-btn').forEach(b => {
            b.className = "py-1.5 rounded-lg text-stone-400 hover:text-white m-rarity-btn";
        });
        const activeBtn = document.getElementById(`m-f-${rarity}`);
        if (activeBtn) activeBtn.className = "py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-vip-gold text-black font-black m-rarity-btn";
        filterMarketCards();
    }

    function filterMarketCards() {
        const query = (document.getElementById('marketSearchInput')?.value || '').toLowerCase().trim();
        const items = document.querySelectorAll('.market-card-item');

        items.forEach(card => {
            const text = card.getAttribute('data-search') || '';
            const cardRarity = card.getAttribute('data-rarity') || '';

            const matchesText = text.includes(query);
            const matchesRarity = (selectedMarketRarity === 'all' || cardRarity === selectedMarketRarity);

            card.style.display = (matchesText && matchesRarity) ? 'flex' : 'none';
        });
    }

    // Filtro por propiedad de carta en el Mercado
    let marketOwnershipFilter = 'all';

    function setMarketOwnershipFilter(mode) {
        marketOwnershipFilter = mode;
        const btnAll = document.getElementById('btn-market-all');
        const btnMissing = document.getElementById('btn-market-missing');
        if (btnAll && btnMissing) {
            if (mode === 'all') {
                btnAll.className = 'flex-1 py-1.5 text-[9px] font-black uppercase rounded-xl bg-vip-gold text-black shadow transition-all';
                btnMissing.className = 'flex-1 py-1.5 text-[9px] font-black uppercase rounded-xl text-stone-400 hover:text-white transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-1';
            } else {
                btnMissing.className = 'flex-1 py-1.5 text-[9px] font-black uppercase rounded-xl bg-amber-400 text-black shadow transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-1';
                btnAll.className = 'flex-1 py-1.5 text-[9px] font-black uppercase rounded-xl text-stone-400 hover:text-white transition-all';
            }
        }
        applyMarketFilters();
    }

    function applyMarketFilters() {
        const cards = document.querySelectorAll('.market-card-item');
        const q = (document.getElementById('market-search-input')?.value || '').toLowerCase().trim();
        const rarity = document.getElementById('market-rarity-select')?.value || 'all';

        cards.forEach(card => {
            const search = card.dataset.search || '';
            const cardRarity = card.dataset.rarity || '';
            const isOwned = card.dataset.owned === '1';

            let matchesQuery = !q || search.includes(q);
            let matchesRarity = rarity === 'all' || cardRarity === rarity;
            let matchesOwnership = marketOwnershipFilter === 'all' || !isOwned;

            if (matchesQuery && matchesRarity && matchesOwnership) {
                card.style.display = 'flex';
            } else {
                card.style.display = 'none';
            }
        });
    }

    document.getElementById('market-search-input')?.addEventListener('input', applyMarketFilters);
    document.getElementById('market-rarity-select')?.addEventListener('change', applyMarketFilters);

</script>
{% endblock %}

                    <span>Botín de la Ráfaga:</span>
                    <span id="cs-tray-count" class="font-bold text-yellow-400">0/10</span>
                </div>
                <div id="cs-live-tray" class="flex gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar py-0.5 min-h-[52px]"></div>
            </div>

            <!-- Botón de Inicio de Giro -->
            <div class="w-full mt-4" id="cs-spin-action">
                <button type="button" id="cs-confirm-btn" onclick="startMultiReelSequence()" 
                        class="w-full btn-gold py-3.5 rounded-2xl text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider shadow-[0_0_25px_rgba(212,175,55,0.4)] flex items-center justify-center gap-2 active:scale-95 transition-all">
                    <span>🗝️</span> <span id="cs-confirm-label">Girar Ruleta</span>
                </button>
            </div>

            <!-- Botón Siguiente durante la secuencia -->
            <div class="w-full mt-3 hidden" id="cs-next-spin-action">
                <button type="button" id="cs-next-btn" onclick="advanceNextSpin()" 
                        class="w-full bg-purple-950 hover:bg-purple-900 border border-purple-500 text-purple-200 py-3 rounded-2xl text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider shadow flex items-center justify-center gap-2 active:scale-95 transition-all">
                    <span>⏭️</span> <span id="cs-next-label">Siguiente Carta</span>
                </button>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- FASE 2: RESUMEN FINAL EN CASCADA (SIN APARICIONES DE LA NADA) -->
        <div id="cs-reveal-phase" class="hidden w-full flex flex-col items-center py-1 relative z-30">
            
            <div id="cs-sunburst" class="absolute w-72 h-72 rounded-full opacity-35 pointer-events-none animate-spin-slow"></div>

            <h3 class="font-serif text-sm font-black text-gold-gradient uppercase tracking-widest text-center mb-0.5 z-10">
                👑 Botín Desenterrado
            </h3>
            <p id="cs-final-summary-sub" class="text-[10px] text-stone-400 font-mono mb-3 z-10">
                10 Photocards añadidas a tu colección
            </p>

            <!-- CUADRÍCULA EN CASCADA CON ANIMACIÓN CARD-DROP -->
            <div id="cs-cascade-grid" class="w-full max-h-[58vh] overflow-y-auto no-scrollbar flex flex-wrap justify-center gap-2.5 p-1 z-10">
                <!-- Se inyectan con animación secuencial escalonada -->
            </div>

            <!-- Botones de Acción Inmediata -->
            <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2.5 w-full mt-4 z-10">
                <button type="button" onclick="reopenCurrentBox()" class="btn-gold py-3 rounded-xl text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider shadow">
                    🔁 Girar Otra Vez
                </button>
                <button type="button" onclick="universalNav('{% url 'idols:my_photocards_album' %}')" class="bg-purple-950 border border-purple-500 text-purple-200 hover:bg-purple-900 py-3 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider">
                    📖 Ver Álbum
                </button>
            </div>
        </div>

    </div>
</div>

<script>
    const AudioCtx = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
    let csAudioCtx = null;

    function getAudioCtx() {
        if (!csAudioCtx) csAudioCtx = new AudioCtx();
        if (csAudioCtx.state === 'suspended') csAudioCtx.resume();
        return csAudioCtx;
    }

    function playCSTick(pitch = 360) {
        try {
            const ctx = getAudioCtx();
            const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
            const gain = ctx.createGain();
            osc.type = 'triangle';
            osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(pitch, ctx.currentTime);
            osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(pitch * 0.45, ctx.currentTime + 0.04);
            gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.28, ctx.currentTime);
            gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.01, ctx.currentTime + 0.04);
            osc.connect(gain);
            gain.connect(ctx.destination);
            osc.start();
            osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + 0.04);
        } catch(e) {}
    }

    function playLockTurn() {
        try {
            const ctx = getAudioCtx();
            const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
            const gain = ctx.createGain();
            osc.type = 'sawtooth';
            osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(160, ctx.currentTime);
            osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(540, ctx.currentTime + 0.2);
            gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.32, ctx.currentTime);
            gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.01, ctx.currentTime + 0.2);
            osc.connect(gain);
            gain.connect(ctx.destination);
            osc.start();
            osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + 0.2);
        } catch(e) {}
    }

    function playWinFanfare(rarity) {
        try {
            const ctx = getAudioCtx();
            const freqs = (rarity === 'legendary') ? [523.25, 659.25, 783.99, 1046.50, 1318.51] : (rarity === 'epic' ? [440, 554.37, 659.25, 880] : [392, 523.25, 659.25]);
            freqs.forEach((freq, idx) => {
                const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
                const gain = ctx.createGain();
                osc.type = 'sine';
                osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, ctx.currentTime + (idx * 0.08));
                gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.35, ctx.currentTime + (idx * 0.08));
                gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, ctx.currentTime + (idx * 0.08) + 0.45);
                osc.connect(gain);
                gain.connect(ctx.destination);
                osc.start(ctx.currentTime + (idx * 0.08));
                osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + (idx * 0.08) + 0.45);
            });
        } catch(e) {}
    }

    function launchConfetti(colorHex) {
        const canvas = document.getElementById('cs-confetti-canvas');
        if (!canvas) return;
        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
        canvas.height = window.innerHeight;

        const particles = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < 75; i++) {
            particles.push({
                x: canvas.width / 2,
                y: canvas.height / 2,
                vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 16,
                vy: (Math.random() - 0.7) * 16,
                radius: Math.random() * 4 + 2,
                color: Math.random() > 0.4 ? colorHex : '#F3E5AB',
                alpha: 1,
                decay: Math.random() * 0.015 + 0.012
            });
        }

        function animate() {
            ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
            let alive = false;
            particles.forEach(p => {
                if (p.alpha > 0) {
                    alive = true;
                    p.x += p.vx;
                    p.y += p.vy;
                    p.vy += 0.28;
                    p.alpha -= p.decay;
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
                    ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, p.alpha);
                    ctx.fill();
                }
            });
            if (alive) requestAnimationFrame(animate);
            else ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
        }
        animate();
    }

    let activeBoxId = null;
    let activeBoxName = '';
    let activeBoxPrice = 0;
    let activeCount = 1;
    let isOpening = false;

    // Estado del Multi-Spin
    let multiWinners = [];
    let currentSpinIndex = 0;
    let sampleCardsPool = [];
    let autoNextTimeout = null;

    function startCaseOpening(boxId, boxName, boxPrice, count = 1) {
        activeBoxId = boxId;
        activeBoxName = boxName;
        activeBoxPrice = boxPrice;
        activeCount = parseInt(count) || 1;

        const totalCost = activeBoxPrice * activeCount;

        const balanceElem = document.getElementById('user-gold-balance');
        const currentBalance = balanceElem ? (parseInt(balanceElem.innerText.replace(/[^0-9]/g, '')) || 0) : 999999;

        if (currentBalance < totalCost) {
            const errorMsg = `Necesitas ${totalCost} 🪙 para abrir x${activeCount} cajas (tu Bóveda tiene ${currentBalance} 🪙).`;
            if (window.showVipAlert) {
                showVipAlert(errorMsg, "Bóveda Insuficiente", "🪙");
            } else {
                alert(errorMsg);
            }
            return;
        }

        const roundBadge = document.getElementById('cs-round-badge');
        if (roundBadge) roundBadge.innerText = activeCount > 1 ? `Ráfaga x${activeCount}` : `Tirada x1`;

        const skipBtn = document.getElementById('cs-skip-btn');
        if (skipBtn) skipBtn.classList.add('hidden');

        const liveTraySec = document.getElementById('cs-live-tray-section');
        if (liveTraySec) liveTraySec.classList.add('hidden');

        const liveTray = document.getElementById('cs-live-tray');
        if (liveTray) liveTray.innerHTML = '';

        const nextSpinAction = document.getElementById('cs-next-spin-action');
        if (nextSpinAction) nextSpinAction.classList.add('hidden');

        const spinAction = document.getElementById('cs-spin-action');
        if (spinAction) spinAction.classList.remove('hidden');

        const confirmBtn = document.getElementById('cs-confirm-btn');
        if (confirmBtn) {
            confirmBtn.disabled = false;
            confirmBtn.innerHTML = `<span>🗝️</span> <span>Girar Riel (${totalCost} 🪙)</span>`;
        }

        const roulettePhase = document.getElementById('cs-roulette-phase');
        if (roulettePhase) roulettePhase.classList.remove('hidden');

        const revealPhase = document.getElementById('cs-reveal-phase');
        if (revealPhase) revealPhase.classList.add('hidden');

        const closeBtn = document.getElementById('cs-close-btn');
        if (closeBtn) closeBtn.style.display = 'block';

        const reel = document.getElementById('cs-reel');
        if (reel) {
            reel.style.transition = 'none';
            reel.style.transform = 'translateX(0px)';
            reel.innerHTML = '<span class="text-xs text-stone-500 italic py-20 px-8 text-center w-full block">Pulsa el botón dorado para desbloquear el Riel Real...</span>';
        }

        const modal = document.getElementById('cs-modal');
        if (modal) modal.classList.remove('hidden');
    }

    window.openReelModal = startCaseOpening;
    window.startCaseOpening = startCaseOpening;

    function reopenCurrentBox() {
        startCaseOpening(activeBoxId, activeBoxName, activeBoxPrice, activeCount);
    }

    function closeCSModal() {
        if (isOpening) return;
        if (autoNextTimeout) clearTimeout(autoNextTimeout);
        const modal = document.getElementById('cs-modal');
        if (modal) modal.classList.add('hidden');
    }

    // Iniciar la secuencia de giros
    async function startMultiReelSequence() {
        if (isOpening) return;

        playLockTurn();
        try { window.Telegram?.WebApp?.HapticFeedback?.impactOccurred('medium'); } catch(e) {}

        const tgId = (typeof window.getGlobalTgId === 'function') ? window.getGlobalTgId() : '{{ tg_id }}';
        const formData = new FormData();
        formData.append('tg_id', tgId);
        formData.append('count', activeCount);
        formData.append('csrfmiddlewaretoken', '{{ csrf_token }}');

        const btn = document.getElementById('cs-confirm-btn');
        const closeBtn = document.getElementById('cs-close-btn');

        if (btn) {
            btn.disabled = true;
            btn.innerHTML = '<span>⏳</span> Iniciando Ráfaga...';
        }
        if (closeBtn) closeBtn.style.display = 'none';
        isOpening = true;

        try {
            const resp = await fetch(`/idols/photocards/open/${activeBoxId}/`, {
                method: 'POST',
                body: formData
            });
            const data = await resp.json();

            if (!data.success) {
                if (window.showVipAlert) showVipAlert(data.error, "Bóveda Insuficiente", "🪙");
                else alert(data.error);

                if (btn) {
                    btn.disabled = false;
                    btn.innerHTML = `<span>🗝️</span> <span>Girar Riel x${activeCount}</span>`;
                }
                if (closeBtn) closeBtn.style.display = 'block';
                isOpening = false;
                return;
            }

            const balanceElem = document.getElementById('user-gold-balance');
            if (balanceElem) balanceElem.innerText = data.nuevo_saldo;

            multiWinners = data.winners;
            sampleCardsPool = data.sample_cards || [data.winner];
            currentSpinIndex = 0;

            // Ocultar botón de inicio y mostrar bandeja si es multi-apertura
            const spinAction = document.getElementById('cs-spin-action');
            if (spinAction) spinAction.classList.add('hidden');

            if (multiWinners.length > 1) {
                const liveTraySec = document.getElementById('cs-live-tray-section');
                if (liveTraySec) liveTraySec.classList.remove('hidden');

                const skipBtn = document.getElementById('cs-skip-btn');
                if (skipBtn) skipBtn.classList.remove('hidden');
            }

            // Ejecutar el primer giro
            executeSingleSpin(currentSpinIndex);

        } catch(e) {
            alert("Error de conexión al girar el relicario.");
            if (btn) btn.disabled = false;
            if (closeBtn) closeBtn.style.display = 'block';
            isOpening = false;
        }
    }

    // Ejecuta 1 giro del carrusel para la carta 'index'
    function executeSingleSpin(index) {
        if (index >= multiWinners.length) {
            finishAllSpins();
            return;
        }

        const currentCard = multiWinners[index];
        const roundBadge = document.getElementById('cs-round-badge');
        if (roundBadge) {
            roundBadge.innerText = `Tirada ${index + 1} de ${multiWinners.length}`;
        }

        const nextAction = document.getElementById('cs-next-spin-action');
        if (nextAction) nextAction.classList.add('hidden');

        const reel = document.getElementById('cs-reel');
        const viewport = document.getElementById('cs-viewport');
        const needle = document.getElementById('cs-laser-needle');

        // Construir 32 cartas de relleno + la ganadora en la posición 24
        const winningSlot = 24;
        const reelCards = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < 32; i++) {
            if (i === winningSlot) {
                reelCards.push(currentCard);
            } else {
                const randSample = sampleCardsPool[Math.floor(Math.random() * sampleCardsPool.length)] || currentCard;
                reelCards.push(randSample);
            }
        }

        // Resetear riel instantáneo
        reel.style.transition = 'none';
        reel.style.transform = 'translateX(0px)';
        reel.innerHTML = reelCards.map((c, i) => `
            <div id="reel-item-${i}" class="w-[125px] h-[190px] rounded-2xl flex-shrink-0 bg-[#0d0417] border-2 flex flex-col justify-between p-1.5 relative overflow-hidden select-none shadow-xl transition-transform"
                 style="border-color: ${c.color}; box-shadow: 0 4px 20px ${c.color}35;">
                <div class="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-tr from-white/10 via-transparent to-transparent pointer-events-none"></div>
                <div class="w-full h-[135px] rounded-xl overflow-hidden bg-black relative">
                    <img src="${c.image_url}" class="w-full h-full object-cover">
                    <span class="absolute top-1 right-1 text-[7.5px] font-mono uppercase font-black px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-md shadow"
                          style="background-color: ${c.color}; color: #000;">
                        ${c.rarity.substring(0, 4)}
                    </span>
                </div>
                <div class="text-center flex flex-col mt-1">
                    <span class="text-[9.5px] font-black text-white truncate leading-tight">${c.name}</span>
                    <span class="text-[8px] font-bold text-yellow-300 truncate mt-0.5">${c.idol_name}</span>
                </div>
                <div class="absolute bottom-0 inset-x-0 h-1.5" style="background-color: ${c.color};"></div>
            </div>
        `).join('');

        reel.offsetHeight; // Forzar reflow

        const cardPitch = 137; // Ancho + Gap
        const containerWidth = viewport ? viewport.offsetWidth : 350;
        const cardCenter = (winningSlot * cardPitch) + 62.5;
        const targetX = - (cardCenter - (containerWidth / 2) + (Math.random() * 16 - 8));

        // Duración: si es 1 sola carta es más lenta (4.8s). Si es ráfaga es dinámica (2.6s)
        const spinDuration = (multiWinners.length === 1) ? 4.8 : 2.6;
        reel.style.transition = `transform ${spinDuration}s cubic-bezier(0.08, 0.95, 0.18, 1)`;
        reel.style.transform = `translateX(${targetX}px)`;

        try { window.Telegram?.WebApp?.HapticFeedback?.impactOccurred('medium'); } catch(e) {}

        // Ticks de sonido durante el frenado
        let ticks = 0;
        const maxTicks = (multiWinners.length === 1) ? 28 : 16;
        let tickDelay = (multiWinners.length === 1) ? 80 : 50;
        function scheduleTick() {
            if (ticks > maxTicks) return;
            playCSTick(380 - (ticks * 8));
            try { window.Telegram?.WebApp?.HapticFeedback?.impactOccurred('light'); } catch(e) {}
            ticks++;
            tickDelay += Math.floor(ticks * 4.5);
            setTimeout(scheduleTick, tickDelay);
        }
        scheduleTick();

        // Al detenerse la aguja sobre la carta ganadora
        setTimeout(() => {
            const winnerEl = document.getElementById(`reel-item-${winningSlot}`);
            if (winnerEl) winnerEl.classList.add('winner-slam');

            if (needle) {
                needle.style.boxShadow = `0 0 40px ${currentCard.color}, 0 0 65px ${currentCard.color}`;
            }

            playWinFanfare(currentCard.rarity);
            if (currentCard.rarity === 'legendary' || currentCard.rarity === 'epic') {
                launchConfetti(currentCard.color);
            }
            try { window.Telegram?.WebApp?.HapticFeedback?.notificationOccurred('success'); } catch(e) {}

            // Agregar a la bandeja inferior con animación Pop
            addCardToLiveTray(currentCard, index + 1);

            // Si es la última carta, finalizar tras 1.2 segundos
            if (index + 1 >= multiWinners.length) {
                setTimeout(finishAllSpins, 1300);
            } else {
                // Mostrar botón de pasar rápido o avanzar automáticamente
                const nextAction = document.getElementById('cs-next-spin-action');
                const nextLabel = document.getElementById('cs-next-label');
                if (nextAction && nextLabel) {
                    nextLabel.innerText = `Siguiente Carta (${index + 2}/${multiWinners.length})`;
                    nextAction.classList.remove('hidden');
                }

                autoNextTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
                    advanceNextSpin();
                }, 1600);
            }

        }, spinDuration * 1000 + 50);
    }

    // Añade la carta ganadora a la bandeja en vivo con sonido Pop
    function addCardToLiveTray(card, currentCount) {
        const tray = document.getElementById('cs-live-tray');
        const countEl = document.getElementById('cs-tray-count');
        if (!tray) return;

        if (countEl) countEl.innerText = `${currentCount}/${multiWinners.length}`;

        const item = document.createElement('div');
        item.className = 'w-12 h-16 flex-shrink-0 rounded-xl overflow-hidden bg-black border relative flex flex-col justify-end p-0.5 shadow-md tray-pop';
        item.style.borderColor = card.color;
        item.innerHTML = `
            <img src="${card.image_url}" class="absolute inset-0 w-full h-full object-cover">
            <div class="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-black via-black/30 to-transparent"></div>
            <span class="relative z-10 text-[7px] font-black text-white truncate text-center">${card.name}</span>
            ${card.is_new ? '<span class="absolute top-0.5 left-0.5 bg-yellow-400 text-black text-[5.5px] font-black px-1 rounded">NUEVA</span>' : ''}
        `;
        tray.appendChild(item);
        tray.scrollLeft = tray.scrollWidth;
    }

    function advanceNextSpin() {
        if (autoNextTimeout) clearTimeout(autoNextTimeout);
        currentSpinIndex++;
        executeSingleSpin(currentSpinIndex);
    }

    // Saltar todos los giros y mostrar el podio completo inmediatamente
    function skipAllSpins() {
        if (autoNextTimeout) clearTimeout(autoNextTimeout);
        finishAllSpins();
    }

    // Fase final: Despliegue de cartas en cascada
    function finishAllSpins() {
        isOpening = false;
        const closeBtn = document.getElementById('cs-close-btn');
        if (closeBtn) closeBtn.style.display = 'block';

        const roulettePhase = document.getElementById('cs-roulette-phase');
        if (roulettePhase) roulettePhase.classList.add('hidden');

        const revealPhase = document.getElementById('cs-reveal-phase');
        const grid = document.getElementById('cs-cascade-grid');
        const sub = document.getElementById('cs-final-summary-sub');

        if (sub) {
            sub.innerText = `${multiWinners.length} Photocard${multiWinners.length > 1 ? 's' : ''} añadidas a tu colección`;
        }

        if (grid) {
            grid.innerHTML = '';
            // Inyectar cartas con animación escalonada (card-drop)
            multiWinners.forEach((card, idx) => {
                const cardEl = document.createElement('div');
                cardEl.className = 'card-drop w-28 h-40 flex-shrink-0 rounded-2xl bg-[#0c0416] border-2 overflow-hidden shadow-2xl relative flex flex-col justify-between p-1.5 select-none';
                cardEl.style.borderColor = card.color;
                cardEl.style.boxShadow = `0 4px 20px ${card.color}35`;
                cardEl.style.animationDelay = `${idx * 75}ms`;

                cardEl.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="w-full h-[105px] rounded-xl overflow-hidden bg-black relative">
                        <img src="${card.image_url}" class="w-full h-full object-cover">
                        ${card.is_new ? `
                            <span class="absolute top-1 left-1 bg-yellow-400 text-black text-[7px] font-black uppercase px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded shadow">
                                ¡NUEVA!
                            </span>
                        ` : `
                            <span class="absolute top-1 left-1 bg-black/80 text-stone-300 text-[6.5px] font-mono px-1 rounded border border-white/20">
                                Repetida
                            </span>
                        `}
                        <span class="absolute top-1 right-1 text-[7px] font-mono uppercase font-black px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded shadow"
                              style="background-color: ${card.color}; color: #000;">
                            ${card.rarity.substring(0, 4)}
                        </span>
                    </div>

                    <div class="text-center flex flex-col mt-0.5">
                        <span class="text-[9px] font-black text-white truncate leading-tight">${card.name}</span>
                        <span class="text-[7.5px] font-bold text-yellow-300 truncate mt-0.2">${card.idol_name}</span>
                    </div>

                    <div class="absolute bottom-0 inset-x-0 h-1" style="background-color: ${card.color};"></div>
                `;
                grid.appendChild(cardEl);
            });
        }

        if (revealPhase) revealPhase.classList.remove('hidden');
        launchConfetti('#F59E0B');
    }

    // Alias de seguridad
    window.confirmOpenCase = startMultiReelSequence;
    window.startReelSpin = startMultiReelSequence;
</script>
{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<div class="flex flex-col gap-4 mt-2 pb-60 max-w-md mx-auto select-none">

    @keyframes potShakeAnim {

<script>
    const AudioCtx = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
    let fusionAudioCtx = null;

    function getAudioCtx() {
        if (!fusionAudioCtx) fusionAudioCtx = new AudioCtx();
        if (fusionAudioCtx.state === 'suspended') fusionAudioCtx.resume();
        return fusionAudioCtx;
    }

    function playBubblingSound() {
        try {
            const ctx = getAudioCtx();
            for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
                setTimeout(() => {
                    const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
                    const gain = ctx.createGain();
                    osc.type = 'sine';
                    osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(220 + Math.random() * 320, ctx.currentTime);
                    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.18, ctx.currentTime);
                    gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, ctx.currentTime + 0.08);
                    osc.connect(gain);
                    gain.connect(ctx.destination);
                    osc.start();
                    osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + 0.08);
                }, i * 90);
            }
        } catch(e) {}
    }

    function playMagicFanfare(colorHex) {
        try {
            const ctx = getAudioCtx();
            [523.25, 659.25, 783.99, 1046.50].forEach((freq, idx) => {
                const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
                const gain = ctx.createGain();
                osc.type = 'sine';
                osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, ctx.currentTime + (idx * 0.09));
                gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.3, ctx.currentTime + (idx * 0.09));
                gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, ctx.currentTime + (idx * 0.09) + 0.45);
                osc.connect(gain);
                gain.connect(ctx.destination);
                osc.start(ctx.currentTime + (idx * 0.09));
                osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + (idx * 0.09) + 0.45);
            });
        } catch(e) {}
    }

    function launchFusionConfetti(colorHex) {
        const canvas = document.getElementById('fusion-canvas');
        if (!canvas) return;
        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
        canvas.height = window.innerHeight;

        const particles = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < 70; i++) {
            particles.push({
                x: canvas.width / 2,
                y: canvas.height / 2,
                vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 14,
                vy: (Math.random() - 0.7) * 14,
                radius: Math.random() * 4 + 2,
                color: Math.random() > 0.4 ? colorHex : '#EAB308',
                alpha: 1,
                decay: Math.random() * 0.015 + 0.012
            });
        }

        function animate() {
            ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
            let alive = false;
            particles.forEach(p => {
                if (p.alpha > 0) {
                    alive = true;
                    p.x += p.vx;
                    p.y += p.vy;
                    p.vy += 0.25;
                    p.alpha -= p.decay;
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
                    ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, p.alpha);
                    ctx.fill();
                }
            });
            if (alive) requestAnimationFrame(animate);
            else ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
        }
        animate();
    }

    let currentTier = 'common';
    let batchCount = 1;
    let selectedCards = []; // Guarda objetos: { id, img, name }

    const TIER_CONFIG = {
        'common':    { needSingle: 4, costSingle: 35,  title: 'Transmutación Común ➔ Rara 🔵', desc: 'Funde 4 comunes para forjar 1 Rara garantizada (prioriza carta nueva).' },
        'rare':      { needSingle: 3, costSingle: 75,  title: 'Transmutación Rara ➔ Épica 🟣', desc: 'Funde 3 raras para forjar 1 Épica garantizada (prioriza carta nueva).' },
        'epic':      { needSingle: 3, costSingle: 150, title: 'Gran Ritual ➔ Épica Superior o 👑', desc: 'Funde 3 épicas: chance de Legendaria 👑 (prioriza carta nueva).' },
        'legendary': { needSingle: 2, costSingle: 200, title: 'Transmutación Legendaria ➔ 👑', desc: 'Funde 2 Legendarias repetidas para forjar 1 Legendaria NUEVA para tu álbum.' }
    };

    function renderSlotsRack() {
        const rack = document.getElementById('cauldron-slots-rack');
        const counter = document.getElementById('slots-count-display');
        if (!rack) return;

        const totalNeeded = TIER_CONFIG[currentTier].needSingle * batchCount;
        rack.innerHTML = '';

        for (let i = 0; i < totalNeeded; i++) {
            const card = selectedCards[i];
            const slot = document.createElement('div');
            slot.className = `w-14 h-20 rounded-xl border-2 flex-shrink-0 relative overflow-hidden transition-all duration-300 flex items-center justify-center select-none ${card ? 'border-purple-400 bg-black shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(168,85,247,0.5)] cursor-pointer active:scale-90' : 'border-dashed border-purple-500/40 bg-purple-950/20'}`;

            if (card) {
                slot.onclick = () => removeCardById(card.id);
                slot.innerHTML = `
                    <img src="${card.img}" class="w-full h-full object-cover">
                    <div class="absolute inset-0 bg-black/25"></div>
                    <span class="absolute top-1 right-1 w-4 h-4 rounded-full bg-red-600/90 text-white text-[9px] font-bold flex items-center justify-center shadow">×</span>
                `;
            } else {
                slot.innerHTML = `
                    <span class="text-stone-500 text-xs font-mono font-bold">+</span>
                `;
            }
            rack.appendChild(slot);
        }

        if (counter) {
            counter.innerText = `${selectedCards.length} / ${totalNeeded} colocadas`;
        }

        updateActionBtn();
    }

    function switchRecipe(tier) {
        currentTier = tier;
        selectedCards = [];

        document.querySelectorAll('.recipe-tab-btn').forEach(b => {
            b.className = "py-2.5 rounded-xl text-stone-400 hover:text-white recipe-tab-btn transition-all";
        });
        const activeBtn = document.getElementById(`btn-tab-${tier}`);
        if (tier === 'common') activeBtn.className = "py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-vip-gold text-black font-black recipe-tab-btn shadow";
        else if (tier === 'rare') activeBtn.className = "py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-blue-600 text-white font-black recipe-tab-btn shadow";
        else if (tier === 'epic') activeBtn.className = "py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-purple-600 text-white font-black recipe-tab-btn shadow";
        else activeBtn.className = "py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-yellow-500 to-amber-500 text-black font-black recipe-tab-btn shadow";

        ['common', 'rare', 'epic', 'legendary'].forEach(t => {
            const grid = document.getElementById(`grid-${t}`);
            if (grid) {
                if (t === tier) grid.classList.remove('hidden');
                else grid.classList.add('hidden');
            }
        });

        document.querySelectorAll('.selectable-card').forEach(c => {
            c.classList.remove('border-yellow-400', 'scale-105', 'shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(234,179,8,0.7)]');
            c.querySelector('.check-mark')?.classList.add('hidden');
        });

        updateRecipeSummary();
        renderSlotsRack();
    }

    function setBatchCount(count) {
        batchCount = count;
        selectedCards = [];

        [1, 2, 3, 5].forEach(num => {
            const btn = document.getElementById(`batch-btn-${num}`);
            if (btn) {
                if (num === count) btn.className = "px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-purple-600 text-white font-black shadow";
                else btn.className = "px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-stone-400 hover:text-white";
            }
        });

        document.querySelectorAll('.selectable-card').forEach(c => {
            c.classList.remove('border-yellow-400', 'scale-105', 'shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(234,179,8,0.7)]');
            c.querySelector('.check-mark')?.classList.add('hidden');
        });

        updateRecipeSummary();
        renderSlotsRack();
    }

    function updateRecipeSummary() {
        const cfg = TIER_CONFIG[currentTier];
        const totalCost = cfg.costSingle * batchCount;

        const titleEl = document.getElementById('recipe-title');
        const descEl = document.getElementById('recipe-desc');
        const costEl = document.getElementById('recipe-cost');

        if (titleEl) titleEl.innerText = `${cfg.title} (x${batchCount})`;
        if (descEl) descEl.innerText = cfg.desc;
        if (costEl) costEl.innerText = `${totalCost} 🪙`;
    }

    function toggleCardSelection(el, cardId, cardImg, cardName) {
        const totalNeeded = TIER_CONFIG[currentTier].needSingle * batchCount;
        const existingIdx = selectedCards.findIndex(c => c.id === cardId);

        if (existingIdx > -1) {
            selectedCards.splice(existingIdx, 1);
            el.classList.remove('border-yellow-400', 'scale-105', 'shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(234,179,8,0.7)]');
            el.querySelector('.check-mark')?.classList.add('hidden');
        } else {
            if (selectedCards.length >= totalNeeded) {
                try { window.Telegram?.WebApp?.HapticFeedback?.notificationOccurred('warning'); } catch(e) {}
                return;
            }
            selectedCards.push({ id: cardId, img: cardImg, name: cardName });
            el.classList.add('border-yellow-400', 'scale-105', 'shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(234,179,8,0.7)]');
            el.querySelector('.check-mark')?.classList.remove('hidden');
        }

        try { window.Telegram?.WebApp?.HapticFeedback?.impactOccurred('light'); } catch(e) {}
        renderSlotsRack();
    }

    function removeCardById(cardId) {
        const existingIdx = selectedCards.findIndex(c => c.id === cardId);
        if (existingIdx > -1) {
            selectedCards.splice(existingIdx, 1);
            const cardEl = document.querySelector(`.selectable-card[data-id="${cardId}"]`);
            if (cardEl) {
                cardEl.classList.remove('border-yellow-400', 'scale-105', 'shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(234,179,8,0.7)]');
                cardEl.querySelector('.check-mark')?.classList.add('hidden');
            }
            renderSlotsRack();
        }
    }

    // BOTÓN ⚡ AUTO-LLENAR REPETIDAS
    function autoFillCards() {
        const totalNeeded = TIER_CONFIG[currentTier].needSingle * batchCount;
        const grid = document.getElementById(`grid-${currentTier}`);
        if (!grid) return;

        const availableEls = Array.from(grid.querySelectorAll('.selectable-card'));
        if (availableEls.length < totalNeeded) {
            alert(`No tienes suficientes cartas repetidas de esta rareza para cubrir x${batchCount} (necesitas ${totalNeeded} cartas).`);
            return;
        }

        // Limpiar selección previa
        selectedCards = [];
        availableEls.forEach(c => {
            c.classList.remove('border-yellow-400', 'scale-105', 'shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(234,179,8,0.7)]');
            c.querySelector('.check-mark')?.classList.add('hidden');
        });

        // Llenar con las primeras N disponibles
        for (let i = 0; i < totalNeeded; i++) {
            const el = availableEls[i];
            const cid = parseInt(el.dataset.id);
            const cimg = el.dataset.img;
            const cname = el.dataset.name;

            selectedCards.push({ id: cid, img: cimg, name: cname });
            el.classList.add('border-yellow-400', 'scale-105', 'shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(234,179,8,0.7)]');
            el.querySelector('.check-mark')?.classList.remove('hidden');
        }

        try { window.Telegram?.WebApp?.HapticFeedback?.notificationOccurred('success'); } catch(e) {}
        renderSlotsRack();
    }

    function updateActionBtn() {
        const totalNeeded = TIER_CONFIG[currentTier].needSingle * batchCount;
        const totalCost = TIER_CONFIG[currentTier].costSingle * batchCount;
        const btn = document.getElementById('btn-do-fusion');
        if (!btn) return;

        if (selectedCards.length === totalNeeded) {
            btn.disabled = false;
            btn.classList.remove('opacity-40', 'cursor-not-allowed');
            btn.innerHTML = `<span>🔮</span> <span>Encender Caldero (${totalCost} 🪙)</span>`;
        } else {
            btn.disabled = true;
            btn.classList.add('opacity-40', 'cursor-not-allowed');
            btn.innerHTML = `<span>🔮</span> <span>Selecciona ${totalNeeded - selectedCards.length} cartas más</span>`;
        }
    }

    // EJECUCIÓN DEL RITUAL ALQUÍMICO
    async function startFusionRitual() {
        const totalNeeded = TIER_CONFIG[currentTier].needSingle * batchCount;
        if (selectedCards.length !== totalNeeded) return;

        const btn = document.getElementById('btn-do-fusion');
        btn.disabled = true;

        const tgId = (typeof window.getGlobalTgId === 'function') ? window.getGlobalTgId() : '{{ tg_id }}';
        const formData = new FormData();
        formData.append('tg_id', tgId);
        formData.append('tier', currentTier);
        selectedCards.forEach(c => formData.append('card_ids', c.id));
        formData.append('ajax', '1');
        formData.append('csrfmiddlewaretoken', '{{ csrf_token }}');

        // Abrir Modal Cinemático en Fase 1 (Ebullición)
        document.getElementById('ritual-phase-boiling').classList.remove('hidden');
        document.getElementById('ritual-phase-reveal').classList.add('hidden');
        document.getElementById('fusion-close-btn').style.display = 'none';

        const potShake = document.getElementById('ritual-pot-shake');
        potShake.classList.add('pot-shaking');

        const progressBar = document.getElementById('ritual-progress-bar');
        progressBar.style.width = '0%';

        document.getElementById('fusion-modal').classList.remove('hidden');
        playBubblingSound();
        try { window.Telegram?.WebApp?.HapticFeedback?.impactOccurred('heavy'); } catch(e) {}

        setTimeout(() => { progressBar.style.width = '100%'; }, 50);

        try {
            const resp = await fetch("{% url 'idols:photocard_fusion' %}", {
                method: 'POST',
                body: formData,
                headers: { 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest' }
            });
            const data = await resp.json();

            if (!data.success) {
                alert(data.error);
                document.getElementById('fusion-modal').classList.add('hidden');
                potShake.classList.remove('pot-shaking');
                btn.disabled = false;
                updateActionBtn();
                return;
            }

            document.getElementById('fusion-gold').innerText = data.nuevo_saldo;

            // Esperar 1.6 segundos para la ebullición mágica y pasar a la revelación
            setTimeout(() => {
                potShake.classList.remove('pot-shaking');

                document.getElementById('ritual-phase-boiling').classList.add('hidden');
                document.getElementById('ritual-phase-reveal').classList.remove('hidden');
                document.getElementById('fusion-close-btn').style.display = 'block';

                const primaryCard = data.cards ? data.cards[0] : data.card;

                document.getElementById('f-modal-name').innerText = primaryCard.name;
                document.getElementById('f-modal-idol').innerText = `Idol: ${primaryCard.idol_name}`;
                document.getElementById('f-modal-img').src = primaryCard.image_url;

                const cardFront = document.getElementById('f-card-front');
                cardFront.style.borderColor = primaryCard.color;
                cardFront.style.boxShadow = `0 0 35px ${primaryCard.color}`;

                const tag = document.getElementById('f-modal-tag');
                if (data.is_new) {
                    tag.innerText = '✨ ¡NUEVA CARTA DESBLOQUEADA EN TU ÁLBUM! ✨';
                    tag.className = 'text-[9.5px] font-mono font-black uppercase tracking-widest bg-emerald-950 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500 px-3.5 py-1 rounded-full shadow animate-bounce';
                } else if (data.is_lucky) {
                    tag.innerText = '🎉 ¡TRANSFORMACIÓN CRÍTICA SUPERIOR! 🎉';
                    tag.className = 'text-[9.5px] font-mono font-black uppercase tracking-widest bg-purple-950 text-purple-200 border border-purple-400 px-3.5 py-1 rounded-full shadow';
                } else {
                    tag.innerText = '✨ ¡Transmutación Exitosa! ✨';
                    tag.className = 'text-[9.5px] font-mono font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-amber-300 bg-black/70 border border-yellow-500/50 px-3.5 py-1 rounded-full shadow';
                }

                // Si se forjaron múltiples cartas, mostrar la fila de las demás cartas
                const multiRow = document.getElementById('f-multi-batch-row');
                if (data.cards && data.cards.length > 1) {
                    multiRow.innerHTML = data.cards.map(c => `
                        <div class="w-20 h-28 flex-shrink-0 rounded-xl overflow-hidden bg-black border relative flex flex-col justify-end p-1 shadow"
                             style="border-color: ${c.color};">
                            <img src="${c.image_url}" class="absolute inset-0 w-full h-full object-cover">
                            <div class="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-black via-black/40 to-transparent"></div>
                            <span class="relative z-10 text-[8px] font-black text-white truncate text-center">${c.name}</span>
                            ${c.is_new ? '<span class="absolute top-1 left-1 bg-yellow-400 text-black text-[6.5px] font-black px-1 rounded">NUEVA</span>' : ''}
                        </div>
                    `).join('');
                    multiRow.classList.remove('hidden');
                } else {
                    multiRow.classList.add('hidden');
                }

                // Efecto Card Flip 3D
                const flipper = document.getElementById('f-card-flipper');
                flipper.style.transform = 'rotateY(0deg)';
                setTimeout(() => {
                    flipper.style.transform = 'rotateY(180deg)';
                    playMagicFanfare(primaryCard.color);
                    launchFusionConfetti(primaryCard.color);
                    try { window.Telegram?.WebApp?.HapticFeedback?.notificationOccurred('success'); } catch(e) {}
                }, 150);

            }, 1600);

        } catch(e) {
            alert("Error de conexión al fundir cartas.");
            document.getElementById('fusion-modal').classList.add('hidden');
            btn.disabled = false;
            updateActionBtn();
        }
    }

    function closeFusionModal() {
        document.getElementById('fusion-modal').classList.add('hidden');
        stayInFusion();
    }

    function stayInFusion() { universalNav('/idols/photocards/fusion/'); }
    function goToAlbum() { universalNav('/idols/photocards/album/'); }

    // Inicializar al cargar
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
        renderSlotsRack();
    });
</script>
{% endblock %}

<!-- SINTETIZADOR DE AUDIO CASINO/RPG WEB AUDIO API -->
<script>
    const AudioContextClass = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
    let sanctuaryAudioCtx = null;

    function getSanctuaryAudio() {
        if (!sanctuaryAudioCtx) sanctuaryAudioCtx = new AudioContextClass();
        if (sanctuaryAudioCtx.state === 'suspended') sanctuaryAudioCtx.resume();
        return sanctuaryAudioCtx;
    }

    function playSoundEffect(type) {
        try {
            const ctx = getSanctuaryAudio();
            if (type === 'feed') {
                [330, 440, 550].forEach((freq, idx) => {
                    const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
                    const gain = ctx.createGain();
                    osc.type = 'sine';
                    osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, ctx.currentTime + idx * 0.07);
                    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.2, ctx.currentTime + idx * 0.07);
                    gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, ctx.currentTime + idx * 0.07 + 0.15);
                    osc.connect(gain);
                    gain.connect(ctx.destination);
                    osc.start(ctx.currentTime + idx * 0.07);
                    osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + idx * 0.07 + 0.15);
                });
            } else if (type === 'pet') {
                [659, 880, 987].forEach((freq, idx) => {
                    const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
                    const gain = ctx.createGain();
                    osc.type = 'sine';
                    osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, ctx.currentTime + idx * 0.08);
                    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.25, ctx.currentTime + idx * 0.08);
                    gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, ctx.currentTime + idx * 0.08 + 0.25);
                    osc.connect(gain);
                    gain.connect(ctx.destination);
                    osc.start(ctx.currentTime + idx * 0.08);
                    osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + idx * 0.08 + 0.25);
                });
            } else if (type === 'evolve') {
                [523, 659, 783, 1046, 1318].forEach((freq, idx) => {
                    const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
                    const gain = ctx.createGain();
                    osc.type = 'triangle';
                    osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, ctx.currentTime + idx * 0.1);
                    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.35, ctx.currentTime + idx * 0.1);
                    gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, ctx.currentTime + idx * 0.1 + 0.5);
                    osc.connect(gain);
                    gain.connect(ctx.destination);
                    osc.start(ctx.currentTime + idx * 0.1);
                    osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + idx * 0.1 + 0.5);
                });
            }
        } catch(e) {}
    }

    function switchSanctuaryTab(tabName) {
        const tabExpeditions = document.getElementById('tab-expeditions');
        const tabSpecies = document.getElementById('tab-species');
        const btnExp = document.getElementById('tab-btn-expeditions');
        const btnSpec = document.getElementById('tab-btn-species');

        if (tabName === 'expeditions') {
            tabExpeditions.classList.remove('hidden');
            tabSpecies.classList.add('hidden');
            btnExp.className = "py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-vip-gold text-black font-black flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 shadow";
            btnSpec.className = "py-2.5 rounded-xl text-stone-400 hover:text-white flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition-all";
        } else {
            tabExpeditions.classList.add('hidden');
            tabSpecies.classList.remove('hidden');
            btnSpec.className = "py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-vip-gold text-black font-black flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 shadow";
            btnExp.className = "py-2.5 rounded-xl text-stone-400 hover:text-white flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition-all";
        }
    }

    function triggerPetTouch(e) {
        spawnFloatingHeart(e.clientX, e.clientY);
        ajaxInteractPet('pet');
    }

    function spawnFloatingHeart(x, y) {
        const heart = document.createElement('div');
        heart.innerText = '💖 +15 XP';
        heart.className = 'fixed pointer-events-none z-50 text-xs font-black text-pink-300 drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(244,114,182,0.9)]';
        heart.style.left = `${(x || window.innerWidth / 2) - 25}px`;
        heart.style.top = `${(y || window.innerHeight / 2) - 20}px`;
        heart.style.transition = 'all 1s cubic-bezier(0.1, 0.8, 0.2, 1)';
        document.body.appendChild(heart);

        setTimeout(() => {
            heart.style.transform = 'translateY(-50px) scale(1.15)';
            heart.style.opacity = '0';
        }, 20);

        setTimeout(() => { heart.remove(); }, 1050);
    }

    async function ajaxInteractPet(action) {
        const tgId = (typeof window.getGlobalTgId === 'function') ? window.getGlobalTgId() : '{{ tg_id }}';
        const formData = new FormData();
        formData.append('tg_id', tgId);
        formData.append('action', action);
        formData.append('ajax', '1');
        formData.append('csrfmiddlewaretoken', '{{ csrf_token }}');

        try {
            const resp = await fetch("{% url 'pets:interact' %}", {
                method: 'POST',
                body: formData,
                headers: { 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest' }
            });
            const data = await resp.json();

            const toastBox = document.getElementById('pet-toast-box');

            if (!data.success) {
                try { window.Telegram?.WebApp?.HapticFeedback?.notificationOccurred('warning'); } catch(e) {}
                if (window.showVipAlert) {
                    showVipAlert(data.error, "Descanso de Mascota", "💤");
                } else {
                    toastBox.innerHTML = `
                        <div class="p-3 rounded-2xl bg-amber-950/90 border border-amber-500/80 text-amber-200 text-xs font-bold text-center shadow-lg">
                            ${data.error}
                        </div>
                    `;
                    setTimeout(() => { toastBox.innerHTML = ''; }, 3500);
                }
                return;
            }

            playSoundEffect(action);
            try { window.Telegram?.WebApp?.HapticFeedback?.notificationOccurred('success'); } catch(e) {}

            document.getElementById('pet-energy-text').innerText = `${data.pet_energy}%`;
            document.getElementById('pet-energy-bar').style.width = `${data.pet_energy}%`;

            document.getElementById('pet-happiness-text').innerText = `${data.pet_happiness}%`;
            document.getElementById('pet-happiness-bar').style.width = `${data.pet_happiness}%`;

            const moodBadge = document.getElementById('pet-mood-badge');
            if (data.pet_happiness >= 80) moodBadge.innerText = '🥰 Devoto & Radiante';
            else if (data.pet_happiness >= 50) moodBadge.innerText = '😊 Alegre';
            else if (data.pet_happiness >= 25) moodBadge.innerText = '🥱 Cansado';
            else moodBadge.innerText = '🥺 Solitario';

            document.getElementById('pet-xp-text').innerText = `${data.pet_xp} / ${data.pet_xp_needed} XP`;
            document.getElementById('pet-xp-bar').style.width = `${data.pet_xp_percent}%`;
            document.getElementById('pet-level-badge').innerText = data.pet_level;

            if (data.cooldown_minutes) {
                document.getElementById('pet-action-label').innerText = `Descanso (${data.cooldown_minutes}m)`;
            }

            if (data.evolved) {
                triggerEvolutionPopup(data);
            }

            toastBox.innerHTML = `
                <div class="p-3 rounded-2xl bg-emerald-950/90 border border-emerald-500 text-emerald-200 text-xs font-bold text-center shadow-lg">
                    ${data.message}
                </div>
            `;
            setTimeout(() => { toastBox.innerHTML = ''; }, 3500);

        } catch(e) {
            console.error(e);
        }
    }

    function triggerEvolutionPopup(data) {
        playSoundEffect('evolve');
        try { window.Telegram?.WebApp?.HapticFeedback?.impactOccurred('heavy'); } catch(e) {}

        document.getElementById('evo-modal-name').innerText = data.new_name;
        document.getElementById('evo-modal-title').innerText = data.new_title;
        document.getElementById('evo-modal-buff').innerText = data.new_buff;
        document.getElementById('evo-modal-img').src = data.new_sprite;

        document.getElementById('pet-avatar-img').src = data.new_sprite;
        document.getElementById('pet-evolved-name').innerText = `${data.new_name}`;
        document.getElementById('pet-buff-text').innerText = data.new_buff;
        document.getElementById('pet-stage-badge').innerText = `Fase ${data.new_stage}/3: ${data.new_name}`;

        // Sincronizar también los títulos superiores
        const headTitle = document.getElementById('pet-header-title');
        const headName = document.getElementById('pet-header-name');
        if (headTitle && data.new_title) headTitle.innerText = data.new_title;
        if (headName && data.new_name) headName.innerText = data.new_name;

        document.getElementById('evolution-modal').classList.remove('hidden');
    }

    function closeEvolutionModal() {
        document.getElementById('evolution-modal').classList.add('hidden');
    }

    let currentLootData = null;

    async function launchExpedition(zoneKey, zoneTitle) {
        const tgId = (typeof window.getGlobalTgId === 'function') ? window.getGlobalTgId() : '{{ tg_id }}';
        const formData = new FormData();
        formData.append('tg_id', tgId);
        formData.append('zone', zoneKey);
        formData.append('ajax', '1');
        formData.append('csrfmiddlewaretoken', '{{ csrf_token }}');

        try {
            const resp = await fetch("{% url 'pets:expedition' %}", {
                method: 'POST',
                body: formData,
                headers: { 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest' }
            });
            const data = await resp.json();

            if (!data.success) {
                if (window.showVipAlert) {
                    showVipAlert(data.error, "Mascota en Descanso", "⏳");
                } else {
                    alert(data.error);
                }
                return;
            }

            currentLootData = data;
            document.getElementById('exp-modal-title').innerText = `Explorando ${zoneTitle}`;
            document.getElementById('exp-modal-subtitle').innerText = `Tu mascota regresó de ${zoneTitle} con un cofre antiguo:`;
            document.getElementById('chest-box').classList.remove('hidden');
            document.getElementById('loot-reveal').classList.add('hidden');
            document.getElementById('expedition-modal').classList.remove('hidden');

            try { window.Telegram?.WebApp?.HapticFeedback?.impactOccurred('heavy'); } catch(e) {}
        } catch(e) {
            if (window.showVipAlert) {
                showVipAlert("Error al conectar con la expedición.", "Aviso", "⚠️");
            } else {
                alert("Error al iniciar expedición.");
            }
        }
    }

    function openFoundChest() {
        if (!currentLootData) return;
        playSoundEffect('pet');
        try { window.Telegram?.WebApp?.HapticFeedback?.notificationOccurred('success'); } catch(e) {}

        document.getElementById('chest-box').classList.add('hidden');
        document.getElementById('loot-reveal').classList.remove('hidden');

        document.getElementById('loot-gold').innerText = `+${currentLootData.gold}`;
        document.getElementById('loot-xp').innerText = `+${currentLootData.xp}`;

        const foodElem = document.getElementById('loot-food');
        if (currentLootData.food_found) foodElem.classList.remove('hidden');
        else foodElem.classList.add('hidden');

        const cardBox = document.getElementById('loot-card-box');
        if (currentLootData.card_dropped) {
            const c = currentLootData.card_dropped;
            cardBox.classList.remove('hidden');
            cardBox.style.borderColor = c.color;
            document.getElementById('loot-card-img').src = c.image_url;
            document.getElementById('loot-card-name').innerText = c.name;
            document.getElementById('loot-card-idol').innerText = `Idol: ${c.idol_name}`;
            
            const badge = document.getElementById('loot-card-rarity');
            badge.innerText = c.rarity_display;
            badge.style.borderColor = c.color;
            badge.style.color = c.color;
        } else {
            cardBox.classList.add('hidden');
        }

        document.getElementById('pet-energy-text').innerText = `${currentLootData.pet_energy}%`;
        document.getElementById('pet-energy-bar').style.width = `${currentLootData.pet_energy}%`;
        document.getElementById('pet-level-badge').innerText = currentLootData.pet_level;

        if (currentLootData.evolved) {
            triggerEvolutionPopup(currentLootData);
        }
    }

    function closeExpeditionModal() {
        document.getElementById('expedition-modal').classList.add('hidden');
    }
</script>
{% endblock %}
